title: Image Ad Creator: Ecommerce Meta Ads and Winning Swipe Research
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We are a health, beauty, and wellness ecommerce company running Meta ads across multiple international markets.



We are looking for an experienced Image Ad Creator who can research strong competitor swipes, understand the concepts behind them, and turn those insights into original static ads for
 and Instagram.



Swipe research is a core part of this role. You must be able to find relevant ads, explain why they are worth testing, and develop variations that preserve the hook, angle, or visual concept behind the reference.



You will work closely with a Creative Strategist and receive feedback based on creative testing, media-buying results, and Meta compliance.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Research competitor ads using the Meta Ad Library and other approved sources.

- Identify strong hooks, angles, offers, layouts, audience problems, and visual concepts.

- Evaluate swipes using available evidence such as reach, impressions, run duration, repeated concepts, advertiser credibility, market relevance, and product fit.

- Save each swipe with its source link, hook, angle, format, and reason it is worth testing.

- Turn approved swipes and creative briefs into original static ads without directly copying competitors.

- Create variations using different hooks, angles, offers, layouts, and visual approaches.

- Produce advertorial, testimonial, product-benefit, comparison, offer, and problem-solution ads where appropriate.

- Use AI tools when appropriate to create or improve product scenes, backgrounds, models, and other creative elements.

- Correct AI-generated problems involving hands, faces, text, labels, lighting, shadows, and product accuracy.

- Follow briefs carefully and confirm the correct product, market, offer, copy, and claims before submission.

- Organize swipe references, source links, working files, and final creatives clearly.

- Revise ads based on strategist feedback, performance results, and rejected-ad learnings.

- Flag risky health claims, misleading visuals, or unclear instructions before proceeding.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Proven experience creating static Meta ads for ecommerce, dropshipping, or DTC brands.

- Strong swipe-research experience and familiarity with the Meta Ad Library.

- A portfolio containing relevant ecommerce image ads and examples of adapting competitor swipes.

- Ability to explain why a swipe may be working based on evidence rather than appearance alone.

- Ability to distinguish available performance evidence from assumptions. Ad longevity or engagement alone does not prove profitability.

- Ability to preserve the core idea behind a swipe while creating an original ad.

- Strong direct-response design skills, including visual hierarchy, typography, readability, layout, and product presentation.

- Proficiency in Canva. Photoshop or Figma experience is a plus.

- Practical experience with AI image-generation or editing tools is preferred.

- Strong attention to product names, labels, offers, markets, claims, and brief requirements.

- Reliable communication and the ability to complete revisions professionally.

- Full-time, long-term availability, with weekend availability when required.



META COMPLIANCE EXPECTATIONS



You must recognize and flag risky elements such as:



- Cure, treatment, or unsupported medical claims.

- Guaranteed results or unrealistic timelines.

- Misleading before-and-after concepts.

- Aggressive personal-attribute language.

- Unsupported authority or doctor claims.

- Celebrity or television-personality lookalikes.

- Offers or discounts that do not match the approved brief.



If a brief or swipe contains a risky claim or visual, ask the Creative Strategist for clarification before creating or submitting the ad.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word SWIPE and answer every question below.



1. How many years have you created static image ads for ecommerce, dropshipping, or DTC brands?

2. Which health, beauty, wellness, supplement, or personal-care products and markets have you worked on?

3. Walk us through how you find strong competitor ads using the Meta Ad Library or other sources.

4. What evidence do you use to d
 whether a swipe or concept is worth testing? Explain how you use reach, run duration, repeated variations, and other available signals.

5. Share one example of a competitor swipe and the original ad you created from it. Include both links, explain what you changed, and share any verified result available.

6. How do you preserve the main reason a swipe works without copying the competitor directly?

7. Which design and AI tools do you use?

8. Describe one ad where you used AI. Explain what you generated and what you corrected manually.

9. How many high-quality static-ad variations can you normally produce per day?

10. What health or beauty claims and visual concepts would make you stop and request a compliance review?

11. Share your CV and portfolio. Prioritize ecommerce static ads, swipe boards, source links, AI-assisted creatives, and performance results where available. Make sure all links are viewable.

12. State your availability, weekend availability, earliest possible start date, and expected monthly salary in USD.



Applications that do not follow the instructions or provide the requested answers and relevant work samples will not move forward.



Qualified applicants will receive a combined image-ad and swipe-research test task after the initial screening.

title: Creative Strategist: Ecommerce Meta Ads, Swipes and Winning Angles
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We are a health, beauty, and wellness ecommerce company running Meta ads across multiple international stores.



We are looking for experienced Creative Strategists who can research strong swipes, develop original angles, write direct-response copy, and guide Image Ad Creators in producing effective static ads.



You must understand ecommerce advertising, customer psychology, creative research, advertorial funnels, and how to turn market insights into concepts that can be tested and scaled. Practical experience with direct-response dropshipping creatives is important.



You will work with Image Ad Creators and the media-buying team to turn research and performance feedback into clear briefs, new concepts, and iterations of proven winners.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Research competitor ads, product pages, advertorials, customer reviews, pain points, objections, and market trends.

- Find promising swipes through the Meta Ad Library and other reliable research sources.

- Evaluate swipes using available reach, impressions, run duration, repeated variations, market relevance, and advertiser credibility.

- Break down the hook, angle, offer, structure, customer desire, and visual approach behind each reference.

- Turn product research and swipe insights into original concepts, direct-response copy, and detailed creative briefs.

- Provide clear source links, copy, visual direction, target audience, offer, and deliverables in each brief.

- Guide Image Ad Creators and ensure their work follows the intended strategy and brief.

- Develop new concepts and test different customer problems, awareness levels, hooks, and angles.

- Create iterations of proven winners while preserving the reason the original creative worked.

- Review campaign performance with the media-buying team and use the results to plan the next tests.

- Maintain an organized testing pipeline across assigned products, stores, and markets.

- Follow Meta compliance requirements for health, beauty, and wellness advertising.

- Report creative winners, failures, learnings, bottlenecks, and next actions clearly.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Proven Creative Strategist experience with ecommerce or dropshipping brands.

- Strong swipe-research, direct-response, and customer-research skills.

- Ability to explain why an ad may be performing and turn that insight into an original concept.

- Ability to distinguish available performance evidence from assumptions. Ad longevity or engagement alone does not prove profitability.

- Strong understanding of hooks, angles, offers, customer awareness, and advertorial funnels.

- Experience writing ad copy and giving clear, actionable instructions to designers.

- Ability to use campaign data when recommending what to iterate, stop, replace, or scale.

- Familiarity with Meta compliance risks involving health and beauty products.

- Clear written and spoken communication for briefs, feedback, and team discussions.

- Ability to manage deadlines and maintain a steady creative-testing pipeline.

- Full-time availability and interest in long-term work.



NICE TO HAVE



- Experience with health, beauty, wellness, supplements, or personal-care products.

- Experience with UK, EU, Canada, Israel, Switzerland, or US markets.

- Experience writing advertorials, product pages, or offer pages.

- Experience leading designers or a small creative team.

- Experience working directly with media buyers.

- A portfolio containing ads, angles, or landing pages that achieved measurable results.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word ANGLE and answer every question below.



1. How many years have you worked as a Creative Strategist for ecommerce or dropshipping brands?

2. Which products, niches, brands, and markets have you worked with?

3. Walk us through your complete swipe-research process.

4. What performance signals do you use to d
 whether a swipe is worth studying? Explain how you use reach, run duration, repeated variations, and other available evidence.

5. Share one winning angle you developed. Explain the research, insight, execution, and result. Include links and verified performance evidence where available.

6. How do you turn a competitor swipe into an original concept instead of copying it?

7. Have you written ad copy, advertorials, or landing pages? Please share examples.

8. How do you use campaign data when d
 what to iterate, stop, replace, or scale?

9. What Meta compliance risks do you watch for in health and beauty advertising?

10. Have you led designers or Image Ad Creators? Describe your briefing and feedback process.

11. Share your CV, portfolio, sample briefs, swipe boards, landing pages, and any redacted performance evidence. Make sure all links are viewable.

12. State your availability, earliest start date, and any existing work commitments.

13. State your expected monthly salary in USD.



Applications that do not follow the instructions or provide the requested answers and relevant work samples will not move forward.



Qualified applicants will receive a Creative Strategist assessment. Applicants who pass the assessment will be invited to an initial interview.

title: Cold Caller / Appointment Setter
description:
We're hiring appointment setters to book qualified discovery calls for our virtual assistant services with US business owners. Your job is to get decision-makers on the phone, spark real interest in offloading work to a VA, and book them into our sales calendar.



Leads are provided. You'll work through company-supplied lead lists, and you're welcome to source your own if you want to expand your pipeline (and your earnings).



This role rewards quality bookings, not busy work. We're not looking for someone who slams the calendar with meetings that never happen. We want appointments that turn into real conversations with real prospects.



What You'll Do





• Work through company-provided lead lists by phone



• Source your own leads when you want to expand your pipeline



• Cold call US business owners in English — live, without a script to hide behind



• Navigate front desks, administrative assistants, and gatekeepers effortlessly to reach actual decision-makers



• Apply core consultative sales fundamentals to uncover pain points, handle objections, and pitch value on the spot



• Qualify prospects against our criteria before booking anything



• Book discovery calls, confirm them, and chase no-shows to a reschedule



• Follow up on every warm lead until you get a clear yes or no



• Log every call, outcome, and note in our CRM cleanly enough for someone else to pick up cold



• Report daily on activity: dials made, conversations had, meetings booked



What We're Looking For



Required:





• Strong foundation in sales fundamentals — you know how to build quick rapport, uncover operational bottlenecks, handle knee-jerk objections, and control the conversation



• Proven gatekeeper navigation skills — you know how to bypass screens, sound like an authority, and get transferred directly to the owner/CEO



• Tremendous spoken English. You'll be calling US business owners live. A clear accent is fine — hesitation, filler, and broken phrasing are not



• Real cold calling experience — proven dials, proven bookings



• Honesty about your numbers. We track everything on our side — dials, connects, show-up rates. Padded activity ends the engagement immediately. If you report it, it needs to be real



• Self-driven. You don't need a manager standing over you to keep dialing. You already know what needs to happen when the phone goes quiet



• Comfortable with rejection and picking the phone back up



• Reliable internet, quiet workspace, clean-audio headset



• Full availability during 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST



Nice to have:





• Experience booking appointments for agencies, staffing firms, or B2B services



• Experience with dialers (Ricochet, Quo, Aircall, or similar) and CRMs (GoHighLevel, Zoho, HubSpot)



• LinkedIn outreach experience to warm up cold prospects



• A track record with actual numbers attached — dials per day, connect rate, booking rate, show rate



Hours & Schedule





• Full-time: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST (Monday to Friday)



• We expect full-time focus on active dialing, pipeline follow-ups, and calendar management — not just idle logged-in time



Compensation





• Base Pay: $50 weekly base salary



• Performance Commission: Competitive commission paid for every qualified discovery call where the prospect actually shows up and joins the call



• Payout structure rewards qualified shows over empty bookings — uncapped earning potential for top performers



How to Apply



Send your application to: 



Include:





1. Updated CV



2. Short video intro in English — introduce yourself, share your favorite strategy for bypassing gatekeepers, and walk us through your best cold calling results with real numbers (dials, meetings booked, show rate)



3. Your typical daily activity — how many dials you make, connect rate, booking rate



4. Confirmation that you can commit full-time to 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST



Applications without a video intro will not be reviewed.

title: E-commerce Video Editor – Short-Form Facebook & Instagram Ads
description:
We’re hiring two full-time video editors to create and localise short-form ads for our e-commerce brands on
 and Instagram.



Most assignments start with an existing video. Your job will be to adapt it for our brands and different markets, updating the voiceover, captions, branding and offers while keeping the ad engaging and natural. You’ll also occasionally create new ads using existing product footage and supplied scripts.



We’re looking for someone who understands how to grab attention in the opening seconds, keep viewers watching and communicate product benefits clearly.



This is a long-term, fully remote role. You’ll work with our editor manager, who provides briefs, answers questions and gives feedback.



Your responsibilities will include:



- Localising existing video ads for different markets and languages using our workflow and tools.

- Creating strong opening hooks that give viewers a reason to keep watching.

- Keeping pacing tight by removing unnecessary pauses and choosing relevant clips.

- Producing natural-sounding voiceovers and adjusting cuts and visuals to match.

- Adding accurate, well-timed captions that are readable on mobile and stay clear of app controls.

- Making product benefits, offers and calls to action clear.

- Checking finished videos for caption errors, incorrect details and leftover original text or branding.

- Applying feedback, completing revisions and occasionally creating simple image ads.

Additional language skills aren’t required. We provide tools and guidance for localisation, but careful checking is essential. Captions must match the final script accurately.



You should have:



- Experience editing short-form e-commerce or direct-response ads.

- A portfolio showing strong hooks, engaging pacing and clear product messaging.

- Confidence using your preferred editing software and working with translation and voiceover tools.

- Strong attention to detail and good written English.

- The ability to meet deadlines, communicate clearly and apply feedback to future work.



Minimum 30 hrs per week. Weekend availability is preferred. Additional weekend hours are available as paid overtime, with extra pay on top of your regular salary.



We value editors who take pride in their work, deliver consistently and flag questions or problems early. We offer regular work, clear guidance and opportunities for performance bonuses based on strong work and results.



To apply, please include:

2. Links to three ads you’ve edited, explaining which parts you handled. (Send your whole portfolio if available)

title: Long-Form YouTube Video Editor
description:
We're looking for a skilled long-form YouTube video editor who goes beyond generic cuts. This is not a Shorts editor role. We need someone who can take raw footage and turn it into high-retention, visually engaging videos that keep viewers watching to the end.



If you edit on autopilot — straight cuts, no b-roll, no on-screen text, no retention thinking — this isn't the role. We're looking for an editor who treats every video like a retention problem to solve.



What You'll Do

Edit long-form YouTube videos end-to-end in Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or equivalent professional NLE

Use b-roll strategically to illustrate points, cover cuts, and keep the visual pace moving

Add on-screen text, callouts, and graphics that reinforce the message and improve retention

Pace cuts, trim dead space, and shape the narrative flow for maximum watch time

Deliver finished videos ready for upload — color-corrected, audio-balanced, thumbnail-friendly

Collaborate on feedback cycles until each video meets quality standards

What We're Looking For



Required:



Proven long-form YouTube editing experience — this is not a Shorts role

Hands-on experience with Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar professional editing software

Strong eye for b-roll selection and placement — knowing when a visual cutaway earns its keep

Skilled at on-screen text and graphics that enhance (not clutter) the video

Understanding of retention mechanics — pacing, hooks, pattern interrupts, visual variety

Excellent English — comfortable understanding native-speaker nuance, humor, and emphasis so edits land correctly

Reliable internet and a workstation capable of handling long-form 4K editing

Ability to meet deadlines consistently



Nice to have (big plus):



Working knowledge of YouTube as a platform — understanding of the algorithm, watch time, CTR, audience retention graphs, chapter markers, end screens, cards, and video SEO

Social media management experience — content scheduling, cross-posting to Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn,
; community management; comment moderation; analytics reporting

Experience uploading and optimizing videos directly on YouTube Studio (titles, descriptions, tags, thumbnails, playlists, metadata)

Ability to repurpose long-form content into Shorts, Reels, and clips for other platforms (bonus workflow skill, not the main role)

Portfolio of long-form YouTube videos you've personally edited (with real view counts)

Experience with specific YouTube niches (education, business, lifestyle, interviews, etc.)

Motion graphics skills (After Effects)

Color grading experience beyond basic correction

Thumbnail design ability

How to Apply



Send your application to: 



Include:



- Updated CV

- Portfolio of 3–5 long-form YouTube videos you personally edited — direct links, with a note on what you did on each (full edit, b-roll pass, graphics, etc.)

- Short video intro in English — introduce yourself and walk through your editing process on one of the videos in your portfolio

- Your software of choice (Premiere, Final Cut, DaVinci, etc.) and years of experience with it

- If applicable: any YouTube channels or social media accounts you've managed or helped grow — with numbers (subs, views, engagement)

- Your weekly availability and typical turnaround time for a 10–15 minute long-form video



Applications without a portfolio of long-form work will not be reviewed. Shorts-only portfolios do not qualify.

title: TikTok Video Editor – Beauty & Personal Care
description:
We are looking for a fast, creative, and reliable TikTok Video Editor to join our e-commerce media team.



Our niche is beauty and personal care products, and we create short-form videos for TikTok, TikTok Shop, Instagram Reels, and other social platforms.



Compensation: $350 USD per month

This is intended as a long-term position for the right editor.



Workload:

Approximately 100 short-form videos per month, averaging around 25 videos per week.



Most videos will be approximately 15–45 seconds long.



The workload may vary from week to week. Some days may require more videos or faster turnaround, while other days may be lighter and more relaxed.



We will provide raw footage, creator/UGC content, product footage, reference videos, and/or editing directions.



Many videos may involve creating different hooks, angles, captions, or variations from the same footage, rather than producing every video completely from scratch.



What You’ll Do



- Edit TikTok and other short-form vertical videos

- Create strong hooks in the first few seconds

- Turn raw product and creator footage into engaging content

- Add captions, text overlays, music, sound effects, zooms, cuts, and transitions where appropriate

- Remove unnecessary pauses and maintain good pacing

- Create multiple video variations from the same footage

- Repurpose UGC and creator footage into different concepts and angles

- Follow current TikTok editing styles and trends

- Highlight product benefits, demonstrations, problems/solutions, and before/after results

- Edit content designed to generate views, clicks, and product sales



Products

You will primarily edit content for:



- Beauty

- Skincare

- Body care

- Hair care

- Fashion/body adhesive products

- Personal care products



Who We’re Looking For

You should:



- Have experience editing TikTok, Reels, or other short-form videos

- Understand TikTok pacing, hooks, captions, and viewer retention

- Be comfortable working with beauty and e-commerce content

- Be able to create multiple creative variations from the same footage

- Work efficiently and meet deadlines

- Follow instructions and reference videos closely

- Have good creative instincts and attention to detail

- Be reliable and communicative



Experience with TikTok Shop, UGC, beauty, skincare, or e-commerce videos is strongly preferred.





To Apply



Please send:



1. Links to 3–5 of your best short-form/TikTok videos, including any examples of beauty, skincare, UGC, TikTok Shop, or e-commerce videos you have edited.

2. The editing software you use.

3. Be prepared to complete an editing test of 1–2 videos. This will help us evaluate your editing speed, TikTok instincts, and ability to create multiple angles from the same footage.



Please start your application with “BEAUTY TIKTOK” so we know you read the full job description.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with our team and work with us long term.

title: Case Manager
description:
We are looking for an experienced Case Manager to join our internal operations team.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, and experienced in managing cases, reviewing documentation, coordinating with attorneys, conducting preliminary research, and keeping multiple cases moving through established processes.



The ideal candidate is proactive, responsive, comfortable working independently, and able to take full ownership of assigned cases, deadlines, documentation, and follow-ups.



Key Responsibilities



Case Management



- Manage assigned cases from initial processing through completion

- Monitor case progress, outstanding requirements, deadlines, and next steps

- Ensure cases continue moving forward and no time-sensitive item is overlooked

- Follow up on missing, incomplete, or incorrect documentation

- Maintain accurate and organized case records

- Escalate issues outside established procedures to management



Document Review & Case Preparation



- Review documents for completeness, accuracy, and consistency

- Maintain confidential legal and case-related documents

- Organize case files and supporting documentation for attorney review

- Prepare case documentation and filing packages according to established procedures

- Track filing dates, receipt notices, case numbers, approvals, and other important milestones

- Ensure required documentation is collected and properly maintained



USCIS & Immigration Case Processing



- Review and assist with preparation of USCIS forms and supporting documentation

- Apply working knowledge of USCIS forms and filing requirements to assigned cases

- Cross-check information between forms and supporting documents

- Assist with preparation and coordination of immigration filings

- Monitor case status and important filing deadlines

- Maintain familiarity with established procedures for PERM, I-140, and related case stages



Attorney Coordination & Research



- Work directly with attorneys regarding case documentation, submissions, and case status

- Conduct preliminary legal and immigration-related research as needed for case preparation

- Research USCIS requirements, procedures, forms, and case-related information

- Prepare summaries or findings for management and attorney review

- Anticipate documentation or information that may be needed during case processing



Communication & Follow-Up



- Communicate professionally with clients/candidates regarding case requirements and updates

- Provide timely written case updates

- Follow up consistently on outstanding documents, information, and action items

title: Case Manager - Lemon Law
description:
Summary

**Remote | California Lemon Law Firm | Full-Time

 

** We are a California law firm focused on lemon law and consumer protection litigation, and we are looking for a licensed attorney to join our team as a Case Manager. 

 

This is a hands-on position for an attorney who can manage cases, communicate directly with clients, stay on top of deadlines, and move cases forward from intake through settlement. 

 

## What You’ll Do 

* Manage an assigned caseload from intake/retainer through settlement or resolution. 

* Communicate directly with clients, provide case updates, answer routine questions, and maintain strong client relationships. 

* Request, review, and organize documents and evidence from clients. 

* Review purchase documents, repair orders, warranty records, service history, manufacturer communications, and other case-related documents. 

* Analyze case facts and identify missing information, potential issues, and case strengths/weaknesses. 

* Draft legal documents, including pleadings, discovery, meet-and-confer correspondence, declarations, motions, settlement documents, and other case-related correspondence. 

* Prepare and file documents with the court and assist with e-filing as needed. 

* Track case deadlines, hearings, discovery obligations, settlement deadlines, and other important dates. 

* Coordinate with attorneys, paralegals, case managers, and other members of the team. 

* Maintain accurate and organized case files and case-management records. 

* Follow cases closely and make sure nothing falls through the cracks. 

* Escalate significant legal or case issues when attorney review or strategy decisions are needed. 

 

## What We’re Looking For **Required:** 

 

* An active attorney license in good standing. 

* Experience handling lemon law cases OR civil litigation. 

* Strong legal writing and analytical skills. 

* Excellent communication and client-management skills. 

* Ability to independently manage multiple cases and competing deadlines. 

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. 

* Ability to work independently in a remote environment. 

* Professional, responsive, and comfortable communicating directly with clients. 

 

## Preferred 

* Direct California lemon law experience. 

* Experience handling cases from intake through settlement. 

* Experience with pleadings, discovery, motions, settlement negotiations, and court filings. 

* Experience using case-management software such as Filevine. 

* Experience working in a remote law-firm environment. 

 

## The Ideal Candidate 

We are looking for someone who can own their cases rather than simply complete individual assignments. You should be comfortable communicating with clients, reviewing documents, drafting legal work, managing deadlines, coordinating with the team, and keeping a case moving without needing to be reminded about every next step. If you have lemon law experience, that's a strong advantage. If you have solid civil litigation experience and can learn the firm's lemon law process, we are also interested in speaking with you. 

 

## How to Apply 

 

Please submit your resume and a brief introduction explaining your relevant lemon law or civil litigation experience. 

 

### Important 

Read Before Applying To confirm that you have read the entire job posting, include the title and author of the latest book you've read in the subject line of your application. Applications that do not include the code word may not be considered.

title: ERP & Inventory Systems Administrator - Full Time, Long-Term Role
description:
ERP & Inventory Systems Administrator – Experienced Candidates Only



$5–$7 USD/hour | Full-Time | 40 Hours/Week | Long-Term Remote Position



We are an established Irish company supplying doors, flooring, hardware and building products. We are looking for a highly experienced ERP & Inventory Systems Administrator to join us long-term.



PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING



This is NOT an entry-level position and NOT a general VA/data-entry role.



You will only be considered if you already have strong, hands-on professional experience working with ERP systems, inventory/stock control and product master data.



We are not looking to train someone from the beginning in ERP or inventory management. We will train the successful person on our specific ERP system, Intact IQ, but you must already understand ERP and inventory systems at an experienced level.



If your experience is mainly general VA work, basic data entry, order entry, Shopify/product uploading or simple administration, please do not apply.



The Role



Our ERP is Intact IQ. Your long-term goal will be to become our internal expert responsible for ERP product data, inventory accuracy and related systems.



Your responsibilities will include:



* ERP & product master data

* SKUs, supplier codes, barcodes and categories

* Inventory and stock control

* Stock takes and variance investigation

* UOMs, pack sizes and conversion factors

* Purchasing and goods received

* Pricing and product data

* Excel/CSV imports and exports

* Bulk product updates and data cleanup

* Product images and specifications

* Website product catalogue

* Identifying inefficient manual processes and improving/automating them

* Working with our external ERP support company



Your First Major Project



We have thousands of products in our ERP currently missing images.



We do not want someone who approaches this one product at a time.



We want someone experienced enough to look for the fastest scalable solution - supplier image libraries, SKU matching, Excel/CSV mapping, bulk downloading, bulk renaming, duplicate/variant matching and automation where appropriate.



If you receive 20,000 records, your first thought should be how to process them efficiently in bulk - not to start manually with record #1.



Experience Required



You should have at least 3 years of genuine hands-on ERP/inventory experience.



Experience with systems such as SAP Business One, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, Sage, Odoo, Intact IQ or another full ERP/inventory system is desirable.



You must be confident with:



ERP systems | Inventory | SKUs | Product Master Data | Stock takes | Stock Reconciliation | UOM | Purchasing | Goods Received | Excel | CSV | Large Datasets | Bulk Updates



Power Query, SQL, scripting or automation experience is a strong advantage.



How to Apply - Applications Will Be Filtered



Start your application with ERP2026.



Applications that do not start with ERP2026 and answer ALL questions below will not be considered.



1. Which ERP systems have you used professionally, for how many years, and what did you personally do within each system?

2. Describe your hands-on experience with inventory, SKUs, stock takes, UOMs and product master data.

3. Give a real example of an inventory/ERP problem you personally investigated and resolved.

4. You receive 20,000 products with missing images and 15,000 are from one supplier. Explain how you would approach this without processing the products individually.

5. ERP stock shows 24 units but the warehouse physically has 17. What would you investigate before adjusting the stock?

6. What Excel/data tools do you regularly use? Include any experience with XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, Power Query, CSV imports/exports, SQL, scripting or automation.

7. Give a real example of a repetitive process you personally made significantly faster or automated.

8. What is your requested hourly rate in USD?



Do not use ChatGPT/AI to write your answers. We know what this looks like and we are only interested in your actual experience and how you personally think and solve problems.



We are looking for one excellent person, not a large number of applicants.



For the right candidate, this is intended to be a stable, full-time position for many years, with increasing responsibility as you become our internal ERP expert.



$5–$7 USD per hour depending on demonstrated experience.

title: Video Editor: YouTube Episodes & Short-Form Clips
description:
Our company is building a YouTube channel and personal brand that earns attention and keeps it. We record long-form episodes on a consistent schedule, and those episodes need to be edited into retention-built videos and clipped down into short-form content fast. That's where you come in. You are the engine that turns raw recordings into polished, ready-to-publish episodes and a steady stream of Reels, Shorts, and TikToks.



This is a consistent volume, deadline-driven role for an editor who treats reliable turnaround as the job, not a nice-to-have. We have a detailed brand and editing guideline you will follow closely, so this role suits an editor who likes a clear standard and hits it consistently.



THE PACE: FAST AND CONSISTENT



- The Window: You work daytime Philippines hours. Footage comes in at the end of the day in Calgary, Canada, and finished edits are returned on a set schedule.

- The Volume: Long-form episodes plus multiple short-form cuts per episode. Consistent, every week.

- The Standard: Fast does not mean sloppy. Every frame ships on-brand and clean the first time.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



- Long-Form Episodes: Edit full YouTube episodes from raw footage into tight, retention-built videos. Cut dead air, tighten pacing, and layer in transitions, B-roll, and visual interest that hold attention from the first frame to the last.

- Retention Editing: Build hooks in the opening seconds, use pattern interrupts and pacing that keep viewers watching, and structure the episode so drop-off stays low.

- Motion & Graphics: Add animated text, lower thirds, callouts, and simple motion graphics that reinforce the point without cluttering the frame.

- Captions: Produce clean, accurate, on-brand captions and animated subtitles built for sound-off viewing.

- Short-Form Clipping: Pull the best 
nts from each episode and cut them into vertical Reels, Shorts, and TikToks with hooks, captions, music, and pacing built for engagement.

- Audio: Duck music under voiceover, clean and enhance audio to my levels, and mix to my delivery standard.

- Brand Guidelines: Learn my style guide (fonts, color codes, caption styles, transitions, thumbnails) early and apply it consistently so edits come back right the first time. Revisions are available when needed, but I'm looking for editors who get it right up front, not ones who rely on multiple rounds to land it.

- Workflow Discipline: Follow my folder structure and file-naming conventions, and return organized project files through my cloud system on schedule, every time.



NON-NEGOTIABLES (PLEASE CONFIRM EACH IN YOUR APPLICATION):



This role lives or dies on reliable turnaround, so your setup matters as much as your skill.



- Location: You must be in or near a major metro (Metro Manila, Cebu, Davao, or similar). I'm not allotting hours for slow upload and download, and I can't have WiFi be the reason an edit is late.

- Internet: Stable wired fiber connection, 100 Mbps up and down preferred (50 Mbps absolute minimum), with no daily downtime. A backup connection is a strong plus.

- Computer: A current, high-spec editing machine that handles long-form 4K footage without lag. List your exact specs (CPU, RAM, GPU, storage).

- Software: Your own licensed editing suite (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut, or CapCut Pro) optimized for fast workflows.



THE MUST-HAVES FOR SUCCESS:



- Deadline-Driven: A finished edit at the agreed time, every time. Reliability is the whole game.

- Experienced: You've edited long-form YouTube content and short-form social before and can show it. You understand retention editing and what keeps a viewer watching.

- Self-Sufficient: You follow brand guidelines closely and nail edits with minimal revisions. You solve problems without hand-holding.

- Consistent: You can do this every single week at a high standard, not just on your best day.



HOW TO APPLY:



To show me you read this, start your application with the word "Rolling" Then send:



- A Demo Reel: Your best long-form YouTube edit (link the full video, not just a sizzle reel) plus one or two short-form clips you cut.

- Your Setup: Internet speed (link a speed test screenshot), full computer specs, and your editing software.

- Your Location: City and your internet provider.

- Retention Approach: One or two sentences on how you keep viewers watching a long-form episode.

- Turnaround Proof: A short note on a time you delivered quality work fast under a tight deadline.



We review every application that follows these steps.

Supportive and collaborative HOA-focused team environment

Building, launching and managing campaigns in Meta Ads Manager 
 and Instagram)

title: Short-Form Video Scriptwriter
description:

title: Senior Amazon Marketplace Growth Manager
description:
SENIOR AMAZON MARKETPLACE GROWTH MANAGER



Salary: $3,500 – $5,000 USD / month (Base) + Aggressive Annual Performance Bonus tied to KPI achievement 

Remote | Full-time | 



*****ABOUT THE ROLE*****



ARE YOU THE SENIOR AMAZON MARKETPLACE GROWTH MANAGER WE’RE LOOKING FOR? 🎸⚡️



If you live for scaling $20M+ accounts, mastering P&L efficiency, and driving exponential growth, we want YOU on our team! Show us what you've got—WE CAN’T WAIT TO REVIEW YOUR APPLICATION AND SEE HOW YOU CAN GROW AND SUCCEED WITH US! ⚡️📈



We are seeking an exceptional, numbers-driven Senior Amazon Marketplace Growth Manager to take end-to-end commercial and operational ownership of our unified Amazon Seller Central account.



Intent Brands operates SurviveX (first-aid and preparedness products) and Aerotrunk (luggage). 

Website: 

: 



Currently generating approximately $20 million in trailing 12-month revenue, our portfolio consists of two category-leading brands: one in First Aid & Emergency Preparedness and the other in Travel Accessories. Both brands operate under a single Seller Central account, presenting significant opportunities for catalog expansion, advertising efficiency, and cross-merchandising.



In this role, you are not simply managing listings—you are the primary owner of the channel’s P&L. You will make high-stakes executive decisions backed by financial rigor, driving profitable top-line and bottom-line expansion. You will orchestrate advertising strategy, listing conversion optimization, promotional calendars, external traffic capture, and strategic relationships (including our Amazon SAS Core partner).



***Role Overview***

We are seeking an EXPERIENCED AMAZON BRAND MANAGER/ P&L DIRECTOR to oversee and scale our $10M–$20M+ Amazon accounts. In this role, you will own the channel's financial performance, optimize conversion rates, guide advertising strategies, and maximize revenue velocity across multiple brand catalogs.



******** KEY RESPONSIBILITIES********



1.) P&L & Financial Leadership: Own end-to-end Amazon P&L across 2 brand catalogs. Analyze unit economics, Landed COGS, Amazon fee structures (FBA, referral, storage, aged inventory surcharges), and contribution margins. Allocate target TACoS % points across product lines to balance profit and growth.



2.) Ad Strategy & External Traffic: Partner with the internal PPC Manager on SP, SB, SBV, and SD campaigns to enforce TACoS discipline aligned with P&L targets. Quantify and leverage external Shopify halo traffic to boost Amazon organic rank and BSR velocity.



3.) Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO): Conduct PDP audits, build creative briefs for the Creative Designer (infographics, Premium A+ Content, copy, video), and run hypothesis-driven A/B tests (via Manage Your Experiments and 3rd-party tools). Reverse-engineer search intent using Amazon SQP and Brand Analytics data.



4.) Merchandising & Promotions: Maximize basket size and AOV using parent/child ASIN structures and Amazon Storefront optimization. Execute and run post-mortems on 7-Day / Best Deals and Prime Exclusive Deals (PEDs) to ensure net-positive incremental velocity.



5.) Operations & Account Health: Partner with the Amazon Technical Specialist on account health, listing suppressions, and stranded inventory. Serve as primary liaison with our dedicated Amazon SAS Core representative to access beta programs and escalate critical issues.



********CANDIDATE QUALIFICATIONS********



**Required Experience**

1.) High-Volume Track Record: 5+ years of hands-on Amazon Seller Central management, with proven success steering high-volume, 8-figure accounts ($10M–$20M+ annual run rate).



2.) P&L Fluency: Thorough understanding of e-commerce financial models, contribution margin analysis, fee structures, and TACoS/ROAS balance.



3.) Advanced Amazon Tooling: Mastery of Amazon Brand Analytics, Search Query Performance (SQP), Manage Your Experiments, Category Insight reports, and the full Amazon Ads console.



4.) Analytical & Data-Driven: Exceptional analytical capability with advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills; ability to turn granular marketplace data into decisive commercial action.



5.) Strategic CRO Expertise: Demonstrated experience developing creative briefs, formulating conversion hypotheses, and executing split-testing protocols.



6.) Autonomous Leadership: Executive presence and proactive mindset capable of managing cross-functional contributors (PPC specialists, technical support, creative designers).



**Preferred Qualifications**

1.) Industry Background: Direct experience with consumer physical products in Emergency Preparedness / First Aid or Travel Gear / Accessories.



2.)Omni-Channel Synergy: Proven ability to leverage Shopify D2C ad spend to boost Amazon organic rank, BSR, and halo sales.

Amazon Programs: Hands-on experience collaborating with Amazon SAS Core or dedicated account management support.



********HOW TO APPLY********

1.) Links to your Updated Resume  & Portfolio



2.) Responses to our screening questions (via a Loom video link or any preferred video recording app)

Screening Questions:

a.)  Background & Fit: Tell us a bit about yourself, your professional background, and how your specific skill set aligns with the qualifications we are looking for.



b.) Account Scale: What is the annual revenue scale of the largest Amazon Seller Central account you have personally managed?



c.) TACoS Strategy: How do you calculate and manage TACoS allocation across SP, SB, and SD formats within a strict P&L framework?



d.) Proven Result: Describe one specific example of a successful listing CRO experiment or promotional strategy you designed and scaled on Amazon.



******COMPENSATION & BENEFITS******

Base Salary: $3,500 – $5,000 USD per month, commensurate with experience and past scale managed.

+ Performance Bonus: Aggressive annual cash bonus tied directly to hitting clear, pre-agreed P&L and growth KPIs.



WE CAN’T WAIT TO REVIEW YOUR APPLICATION AND DISCUSS HOW WE CAN SUPPORT YOUR STRATEGIC VISION! 🏆🔥

title: Remote Customer Service Specialist | E-Commerce Helpdesk (Enterprise Hardware)
description:
Company: Server Part Deals (Server Tech Solutions, Inc.)

Work Setup: Full-time, Remote

Schedule: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM Eastern Time (US)



ABOUT US

Server Part Deals is one of the largest online sellers of enterprise storage — refurbished enterprise hard drives, SSDs, and server components. We ship thousands of orders a month through multiple storefronts including eBay, Amazon, Walmart, Newegg, Shopify, and our own site, serving customers ranging from homelab builders to data centers, across the US and internationally. Our customer service reputation is a core business asset, and this role helps protect it.



ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll join a small, high-performing remote CS team resolving customer tickets across all our marketplaces through our helpdesk platform (eDesk). This is a high-volume, writing-intensive role — our current specialists resolve 50–70 tickets per day with fast handling times and a high first-contact resolution rate, and that's the bar. You'll be trained thoroughly on our products, policies, and tools, with a documented knowledge base and direct support from our CS Manager, plus a clear path to expanded authority (refund approvals, exception handling) as you demonstrate accuracy.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Resolve customer inquiries across all storefronts: order status, tracking, product/compatibility questions, returns, warranty claims, and shipping issues

Initiate and process RMAs within our returns system, following documented policy

Follow marketplace-specific messaging rules and policies (eBay, Amazon, Walmart, Newegg) — accuracy here directly affects our seller account health

Screen orders for red flags: suspicious shipping addresses, potential fraud, pricing or listing errors — and flag them before they ship

Use, maintain, and suggest improvements to response templates and macros

Escalate complex cases to the CS Manager with clear, complete internal notes

Participate in a weekly quality-review process and apply feedback quickly



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

2+ years of e-commerce customer service experience, ideally including eBay and/or Amazon marketplace support

Proven ability to sustain high ticket volume (50+ tickets/day) without sacrificing accuracy or tone

Excellent written English — clear, professional, and warm; most of this job is writing

Experience with a helpdesk platform (eDesk, Zendesk, Freshdesk, Gorgias, or similar)

Strong attention to detail — you notice when something about an order looks wrong

Self-directed and reliable in a remote setting: quiet workspace, dependable high-speed internet, consistent schedule

Comfortable learning technical products — you don't need to be a hardware expert on day one, but you need to want to become one



BONUS POINTS FOR

Knowledge of PC/server hardware (hard drives, SSDs, RAID, servers) or experience selling refurbished electronics

Experience with Amazon Seller Central or eBay Seller Hub case handling

Shopify admin experience

title: Accounting & AR/AP Specialist
description:
Accounting & AR/AP Specialist



**Remote | Full-Time**



We are looking for a highly organized and detail-oriented **Accounting & AR/AP Specialist** to join our team and take ownership of a combination of accounting, accounts receivable/accounts payable, and administrative responsibilities.



This is a **hands-on role** that requires someone who understands accounting processes and is comfortable working with numbers. While the position includes administrative and CRM-related tasks, this is **not a basic data-entry role**.



You should be able to look at a transaction, invoice, payment, or balance and understand how the numbers should flow through the process — and recognize when something doesn't look right.



What You'll Be Doing



QuickBooks & Accounting



* Maintain and update our QuickBooks records.

* Categorize financial transactions accurately.

* Update payroll-related information, including W-2s, 1099s, and Wise payment information.

* Reconcile company credit cards on a monthly basis.

* Review, categorize, and maintain employee expenses.

* Prepare reports as needed.

* Identify discrepancies, missing information, or unusual transactions and escalate them appropriately.



AR/AP & Financial Administration



* Collect and record fees in our internal CRM, ESPO.

* Respond to
s regarding collected fees and payments.

* Create and process invoices.

* Create e-checks.

* Review payment and missing-check lists and update records as payments are received.

* Ensure invoices, payments, fees, and outstanding balances are accurately recorded.

* Review financial information and supporting documentation for accuracy.

* Assist with other routine AR/AP and accounting administrative tasks.



ESPO CRM



* Maintain accurate financial and administrative information in ESPO.

* Update records as invoices, payments, checks, and fees are processed.

* Review records for missing or inconsistent information.

* Understand the workflow and calculations behind the information being entered.

* Ensure ESPO accurately reflects the underlying financial activity.



Administrative Support



* Save and organize POAs, MAs, and other documentation in Google Drive.

* Send required documents to the appropriate
 accounts.

* Maintain organized digital records.

* Assist the accounting and operations teams with additional administrative tasks as needed.



What We're Looking For



Required:



* Previous experience in bookkeeping, accounting, AR/AP, or accounting administration.

* Strong working knowledge of QuickBooks.

* Understanding of basic accounting principles.

* Experience with invoicing, payments, reconciliations, and transaction tracking.

* Strong numerical and analytical skills.

* Excellent attention to detail.

* Ability to identify discrepancies rather than simply entering information.

* Strong written English and professional
 communication.

* Good organizational and time-management skills.

* Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

* Proficiency with Google Workspace, particularly Google Drive.



Preferred:



* Experience with QuickBooks Online.

* Experience working with CRM systems.

* Experience with payment processing or collections.

* Experience working with international or US-based companies.

* Experience handling both accounting and administrative responsibilities.



The Ideal Candidate



We're looking for someone who is numbers-oriented, proactive, and process-driven.



You should be the type of person who doesn't simply enter a number because it's on a document. You should be able to ask:



**"Does this amount make sense?"**

**"Where did this payment come from?"**

**"Why doesn't this balance reconcile?"**

**"Is something missing here?"**



You will be working across QuickBooks, ESPO, Google Drive,
, and other internal systems, so you need to be comfortable learning processes and moving between different platforms.



Accuracy is extremely important in this role. We need someone who takes ownership of their work, catches errors, follows through on outstanding items, and keeps records organized.



What We Offer



* Full-time remote position

* Long-term opportunity with a growing US-based company

* Stable, ongoing work

* Opportunity to take ownership of an important accounting and administrative function

* Collaborative and supportive remote team environment



How to Apply



Please submit:



1. Your updated resume/CV.

2. A brief summary of your experience with QuickBooks and AR/AP.

3. Your expected hourly salary in USD.





**Important:** Applications that do not provide the requested information may not be considered.

title: Virtual Assistant - Sales & Marketing
description:
Filtrous supplies lab consumables and PCR reagents to clinical diagnostic, pharma, cannabis,

food and research labs. As our Sales & Marketing Virtual Assistant, you keep the engine

behind our sales team running: sending outreach, making sure every reply gets a fast and

correct answer, keeping customer and pricing records clean, keeping our Shopify store

current, and gathering the numbers we need to choose the best overseas vendors. You will

work from clear templates and instructions, and you will own the follow-through so nothing

falls through the cracks.



Key Responsibilities:

Outreach & Inbox Management

● Send the cold
 campaigns provided to you, on schedule, with 100% of each

assigned list sent and logged.

● Triage every inbound reply within 1 business day: answer routine replies using the exact

approved templates, and forward high-value replies (buying signals, quote requests,

decision makers) to the right sales rep the same day.

● Keep zero
s unanswered for more than 1 business day and zero contacts answered

twice.



CRM & Contact Data (Acumatica)

● Research and fill in contact details (name, title,
, phone, lab, institution) for faculty

and lab contacts in Acumatica, completing at least 50 verified records per week.

● Check for an existing record before creating a new one, so the CRM stays free of

duplicate contacts and accounts.

● Maintain the faculty contact system so every contact has an owner, a status and a clear

next step.



Pricing & Shopify Operations

● Update the existing price sheet whenever a pricing change is requested, and have it

ready for review within 1 business day.

● Keep the price sheet system organized, versioned and accurate, with zero unreviewed

changes going live.

● Prepare and upload the product assets you are given to Shopify (for example, removing

backgrounds from product photos), live within 2 business days of request.

Vendor Communication & Analysis

● Maintain ongoing communication with our vendors in China by
 and messaging

apps, following up until every requested quote is in.

● Compile vendor quotes into one side-by-side comparison (unit price, MOQ, lead time,

shipping cost, payment terms, quality documents) within 2 business days of receiving

them, so the best vendor can be picked quickly.

What problems will you solve?

● Replies and leads slip through the cracks when the team is busy. You make sure every

 gets one fast, correct answer and every hot lead reaches sales the same day.

● Our customer data, price sheets and store listings fall out of date. You keep them clean,

current and free of duplicates.

● Vendor decisions get made on incomplete numbers. You gather the quotes and lay them

out so we can pick the best supplier quickly.



Qualifications:

● Bachelor's degree preferred but not required.

● 2+ years of experience as a virtual assistant, sales assistant or operations assistant.

● Proven track record of managing a busy shared inbox and following written templates and

procedures exactly.

● Experience with a CRM or ERP (Acumatica preferred; HubSpot, Salesforce or NetSuite

also welcome).

● Experience with Shopify and basic image editing (background removal with Canva,

Photoshop or similar).

● Strong Google Sheets skills (sorting, filtering, lookups) and experience researching

contact information online.

● Working understanding of AI tools (for example ChatGPT or Claude) and how to use them

to work faster and more accurately; comfortable learning new software.

● Experience communicating with overseas suppliers is a plus; background in lab supplies,

life sciences or B2B distribution is a plus.

● Excellent written and spoken English, strong attention to detail, and the ownership to

close every loop without being reminded.

Filtrous is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to creating an

inclusive environment for all employees.



Job Type: Part-time, 25 hours per week

Pay: $6.00 - $8.00 per hour

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM - 1:30 PM Central Time (USA)

Work Location: Remote

Working Conditions:

● Fully remote. You will need a reliable computer and internet connection.

● Occasional early or late messages may be needed to reach vendors in China.

title: Amazon PPC Advertising Specialist
description:
We are looking for an experienced Amazon PPC Advertising Specialist who understands how to take established brands with proven success on Shopify/DTC and successfully launch and scale them on Amazon.



This role requires more than simply managing existing campaigns. Many of the brands you will work with are established businesses but are new or relatively new to Amazon. These accounts require close attention, frequent optimization, and careful campaign development during the early stages.



What You'll Be Responsible For

Build Amazon PPC campaign structures for new and growing Amazon accounts

Develop launch strategies for brands with established Shopify/DTC sales

Perform keyword and competitor research before and during launches

Build and manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display campaigns

Manage Exact, Phrase, Broad, Broad+, product targeting, and category targeting appropriately

Closely monitor new campaigns and make frequent bid and budget adjustments

Analyze search term reports and continually develop keyword targeting

Move converting search terms into more controlled campaign structures

Manage branded, non-branded, competitor, and product-targeting strategies

Scale advertising while monitoring ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, conversion rate, CPC, and overall sales

Identify when campaigns need more budget versus when spend needs to be controlled

Work closely with inventory levels so advertising does not create unnecessary stock issues

Identify listing or conversion problems that are preventing PPC from scaling

Provide clear reporting on performance, opportunities, problems, and next steps

What We're Looking For



You should have hands-on experience managing Amazon PPC accounts and understand that launching an established Shopify brand on Amazon requires a different approach than simply taking over a mature Amazon account.



We're looking for someone who understands how to:



Build an account correctly from the beginning

Generate initial traffic and sales without wasting spend

Develop search-term data and identify winning keywords

Protect branded traffic

Target competitor brands correctly

Scale winning campaigns

Control wasted spend

Balance ACOS and TACOS with overall growth

Recognize when PPC is not the problem and the listing, pricing, reviews, inventory, or offer needs attention



Attention to detail is extremely important. New accounts need close grooming and care. We do not want someone who launches campaigns and checks them once a week. You should be comfortable actively monitoring performance, identifying issues quickly, and making adjustments as the account develops.



Amazon PPC Knowledge Required



You should have a strong understanding of:



Sponsored Products

Sponsored Brands

Sponsored Display

Keyword targeting

Product/ASIN targeting

Broad, Broad+, Phrase, and Exact match types

Branded vs. non-branded campaign strategy

Competitor conquesting

Search term harvesting

Negative keywords/targets

Bid optimization

Placement adjustments

Budget management

ACOS and TACOS

Campaign scaling

New-product launches

Ideal Candidate



The ideal person is analytical but also proactive. We don't want someone who simply follows an automated optimization routine.



You should be able to look at an account and explain:



What's working? What's not working? Why? What should we change? Where should we spend more? Where should we pull back? And what needs to happen next to scale the brand?



Experience helping established Shopify/DTC brands expand onto Amazon is highly preferred.



When Applying



Please include:



How many years you have managed Amazon PPC.

Examples of Amazon accounts or brands you have helped launch or scale.

Typical monthly advertising spend you have managed.

Your approach to launching PPC for an established Shopify brand that is new to Amazon.

How you use Broad, Broad+, Phrase, and Exact differently.

How you approach branded and competitor-brand targeting.

How often you review and optimize a newly launched Amazon account.

An example of an account where you successfully scaled sales while managing TACOS/ACOS.



Optional Video Introduction



You are also welcome to include a short video introduction with your application. This is optional, but encouraged.



In the video, briefly introduce yourself and tell us about your Amazon PPC experience, the types of accounts you have managed, and your experience launching or scaling brands on Amazon.



This does not need to be professionally produced. A simple, short introduction is perfectly fine and gives us an opportunity to learn more about you and your experience beyond the written application.



Please provide specific answers. Generic or AI-generated PPC responses without examples of actual Amazon advertising experience will not be considered.



Position will begin as part time but can easily become a full time position once proven. 



walmart experience nice to have! could be some potential walmart ad opportunity in addition to amazon

The Account Development Coordinator will handle daily operational tasks for all accounts affiliated with the Account Development Representatives and Account Executives. Their main responsibilities will include managing same-day freight and accruing spot freight opportunities, while regularly updating shipment statuses to ensure timely pickups and deliveries. Working closely with the Operations Department, ADRs and AEs, the ADC will strive to gain a better understanding of how to effectively develop accounts and understand the responsibilities of managing the customer facing side of our business. The end goal is promotion to the next Account Development Representative.



The Ally Logistics team is committed to hustling each day, because #HUSTLE means something more here. Our mission as a company is To Move Freight, Better. This mission bleeds into everything we do, as we are continually on a quest for better - better service, better communication, better culture, better technology, better growth. Click here to learn more about what it’s like to work at Ally Logistics.



KEY ATTRIBUTES FOR SUCCESS:

HUMBLE: Confidence is key, but so is humility. Our #HUSTLE values say it all.

HUNGRY: A healthy sense of competition is a necessity here. We’re seeking individuals who are striving for both professional and financial success, and who are seeking any and all opportunities for growth.

SMART: We’re looking for individuals who are resourceful and organized problem-solvers, diving head first into problems rather than straying away from them.





PRIMARY JOB DUTIES:

• Assist in Securing Spot Freight Opportunities: Actively engaged with the ADR and AE team to secure coverage for freight yet to be awarded for all modes of transportation.

• Coordinate Same-Day/Hot Shipments Shipments: Ensure timely pickups by managing and posting all same-day/Hot shipments to load boards, coordinating coverage effectively.

• Track and Update Shipments: Monitor and update the status of all shipments related to the account. Assist with collecting Proof of Delivery (POD), Bills of Lading (BOL), and other necessary documentation to ensure loads are closed out and invoiced promptly.

• Collaborate with Account Development Representatives, Account Executives and the Operations Department: Work closely with Account Development Representatives (ADR) and Account Executives (AE) to ensure adequate coverage on both awarded and spot freight opportunities within a network of repeat or owned carriers, coordinating in advance to meet shipping requirements.

• Leverage Technology: Utilize all available technology and software applications to enhance data collection and coverage, aiming to optimize the success of the account.

• Handle Account Support: Gradually take on additional responsibilities such as load building, scheduling, requesting accessorial charges, and providing customer updates as needed along with managing your own accounts.

• Optimize Operational Efficiency: Continuously seek out and implement improvements to streamline operations and enhance service delivery for the ADR and AE accounts.

• Maintain Customer Relationships: Develop and maintain strong relationships with customers, addressing any concerns or issues promptly to ensure satisfaction.



DAY TO DAY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Professional, timely and efficient communication with operations (i.e. Proactive update requests, collecting paperwork, monitor tracking updates)

• Professional, timely and efficient communication with customers (i.e. Providing updates to delays upon request, proactive updates, quoting)

• Bid on ALL spot market opportunities that fit Ally’s capabilities

• Utilize leadership for all questions and concerns regarding an account

• Ensure loads are being built and scheduled in a timely manner

• Close loads out in a timely manner

• Respond to billing needs (POD, lumper, etc)

• Create Customer SOPs for ALL accounts

• Set up customer calls and check-ins

• Determine the best equipment type (i.e. Could this be partial?)



Additional Requirements

Reliable high-speed internet and computer

Webcam + microphone for Zoom calls

Quiet, professional workspace

2. Availability Requirements

Ability to work U.S. Eastern Time

Must provide advanced notice for planned time off

Must maintain consistent communication (Slack responsiveness,
, etc.)

This is a full-time role: 35 working hours per week, Monday to Friday, within Perth business hours (9am–5pm). We will agree the daily schedule and breaks before you start. 



The base pay is AUD $500 per week, plus commission on deals you help close. We will agree how commission is calculated and paid before you start.

AI already handles much of the form-filling and drafts
s, but it is not perfect. Your job is to learn how the business runs, check the work, and catch what it misses. For example, a client sends last year’s payslips, or a vehicle registration does not match the tax invoice. You spot the issue, organise the follow-up, and flag it to me before anything goes to a client or lender. Nothing is sent or submitted until I approve it.

You do not need finance experience, but it would be beneficial. You do need to be organised, pay attention to detail, and see jobs through from start to finish. You should be comfortable learning new tools, asking questions when something is unclear, and keeping me informed.



I’m interested in examples of times you spotted a mistake, solved a problem independently, created a project with AI or took responsibility for completing a piece of work. These examples can come from employment, running a business, study, or your own projects.

title: E-Commerce Manager - Shopify Plus
description:
USA Roller Chain & Sprockets



E-Commerce Manager - Shopify Plus







Location: Remote -- Philippines







Fifty Thousand Products. One Massive Digital Opportunity.



USA Roller Chain & Sprockets is a fast-growing, family-owned power transmission distributor headquartered in Clermont, Florida, and we have been powering American industry since 2001. We sell power transmission products to customers throughout the United States and around the world. Our Shopify Plus website contains more than 50,000 products and supports a growing volume of B2B demand. We are looking for a hands-on e-commerce professional who can keep this complex digital engine organized, optimized, and moving forward.







Our core values: 



Integrity - Innovation - Commitment - Respect - Empathy -Striving for Excellence







USA Roller Chain & Sprockets is seeking a technically capable and detail-oriented E-Commerce Manager to oversee the daily operation and continued development of its Shopify Plus website. This is not a "set it and forget it" website. With more than 50,000 products, thousands of collections, technical resources, and frequent updates, the platform is constantly evolving. You will manage product data, improve site organization, support front-end updates, monitor performance, and coordinate with internal leadership and external development partners.







The ideal candidate combines hands-on Shopify expertise with strong catalog-management, analytical, SEO, and project-coordination skills. You do not need to be located in Florida, but you must communicate clearly, work independently, and maintain reliable overlap with the company's U.S. Eastern Time business hours.







Key Responsibilities



Manage and maintain the company's Shopify Plus storefront

Perform regular website updates, configurations, and quality checks

Maintain a catalog containing more than 50,000 products

Complete bulk updates to titles, descriptions, tags, prices, images, and attributes

Organize products into accurate, scalable collections and categories

Improve site navigation, filtering, search, and product discovery

Add new products and update existing product information

Maintain consistent product taxonomy and data standards

Identify and correct broken links, inaccurate content, and website errors

Make light front-end changes using HTML, CSS, and Shopify Liquid

Support new Shopify features, applications, integrations, and improvements

Coordinate projects with external developers, agencies, and marketing partners

Translate business needs into clear technical tasks

Review and test updates before and after launch

Support technical and on-page SEO improvements

Optimize product pages, collections, and educational content

Monitor traffic, conversion rate, average order value, and revenue performance

Use site data to recommend improvements to merchandising and user experience

Support promotions, campaigns, product spotlights, and new content

Help bring more e-commerce capabilities and institutional knowledge in-house





Qualifications



Two or more years of verifiable, hands-on Shopify experience

Shopify Plus experience strongly preferred

Demonstrated experience managing a large or technically complex product catalog

Proficiency with Shopify Admin and bulk CSV operations

Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and Shopify Liquid

Experience with product taxonomy, attributes, collections, tags, and filters

Understanding of technical and on-page SEO best practices

Experience with Shopify Analytics, Google Analytics, or comparable tools

Ability to identify and troubleshoot website and product-data issues

Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy

Comfortable coordinating with developers and external agencies

Strong written and verbal English communication skills sufficient to collaborate with U.S.-based colleagues, vendors, and partners. 

Able to work independently and manage competing priorities

Reliable internet connection and availability during agreed working hours

Experience with industrial, technical, or B2B e-commerce is a plus

Experience with large SKU environments and third-party integrations is highly preferred

Schedule: Candidates must be available for at least 4 hours of overlap with U.S. Eastern Time business hours. Specific working hours will be agreed upon before engagement. 





*Preferred remote-work setup: To support consistent availability, candidates are encouraged to have a reliable backup plan for both internet connectivity and power outages. This may include a mobile hotspot or secondary internet provider, along with a UPS, inverter, battery system, or generator. While not strictly required, having these safeguards is strongly preferred. 







Compensation



Full-time, remote position

Pay: $18-$25 per hour, depending on experience and location





Why USA Roller Chain & Sprockets?



This is not another small Shopify store with a few dozen products, and nothing left to build. You will work on a large, active B2B platform with more than 50,000 products, ongoing development needs, strong organic visibility, and real revenue impact. The company is investing in bringing more digital expertise in-house and wants someone who can grow with the platform. If complex catalogs make you curious instead of nervous, this may be the challenge you have been looking for.
