title: AI Creative Specialist
description:
TO APPLY

If this opportunity feels like the perfect fit for you and you meet the job qualifications, we invite you to learn more about our HiEnd Accents team in the Philippines and submit your application here:


com/appzq4iqeIREQRVyo/pagWFW91EJQpT08fw/form NOTE: Change the word "(dot)" to an actual dot.



Applications submitted through onlinejobs.ph will not be reviewed.



JOB DESCRIPTION



We're looking for a full-time AI Creative Specialist to lead the creation of AI-generated product imagery, lifestyle scenes, and short-form video for our brands, including HiEnd Accents and Paseo Road. You'll take our products from a flat studio shot to fully-realized lifestyle photography and video creative used across our website, paid social ads, email campaigns, and Pinterest. You'll own the full pipeline: writing prompts, generating images and videos with tools like Gemini (Nano Banana Pro), Midjourney, Kling, and Veo, finishing them in Photoshop/Canva if needed, and assembling them into finished ad creatives.



We are looking for a long-term tea
mber who will stay and grow at our company. We offer competitive compensation and a good work environment.





WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Generate photorealistic lifestyle product photography using AI image tools (Gemini / Nano Banana Pro, Midjourney, or similar), placing our bedding, pillows, rugs, and home textiles into believable room scenes, on-model shots, and editorial-style compositions



- Animate hero images into short-form video using Kling, Veo 3/3.1, or comparable image-to-video tools for use in Meta ads, Pinterest, TikTok, and on-site PDP video



- Write, test, and continuously refine your own prompts, building reusable prompt templates and a library of looks that maintain visual consistency across each brand



- Build finished static and video ad creatives (Meta, Pinterest, Google) by combining AI-generated imagery with on-brand text overlays, logos, and sizing variants



- Finish and retouch every AI output in Photoshop, Canva, and/or Lightroom, fixing hands, edges, lighting, fabric texture, and any AI artifacts before delivery so nothing leaves your hands looking AI-generated



- Quality-check every output against the actual product reference photos before anything goes out the door, comparing print patterns, color, scale, flange widths, fabric texture, stitching, and proportions to the real product side by side, and regenerating or retouching until the match is exact



- Maintain brand consistency across every output, staying within each brand's color palette, lighting style, prop language, and overall aesthetic (HiEnd Accents vs. Paseo Road vs. our other brands)



- Iterate quickly on feedback from the marketing and creative teams, delivering multiple variations and revisions per brief



- Organize and tag final assets in our shared library (Google Drive, Airtable, Notion) so the rest of the team can find and reuse them



- Track what's working, which creatives are performing on ads, which prompts are producing the best output, and feed those learnings into the next round



- Stay current on new AI image and video tools, model updates, and prompting techniques, and bring promising ones to the team





WHO YOU ARE



- Significant prior experience generating photorealistic product or lifestyle imagery with AI tools (Gemini / Nano Banana Pro, Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, or similar) required



- Strong prompt engineering skills: you can read a product brief and write a prompt that nails the scene, mood, and composition on the first or second pass



- Hands-on experience with AI image-to-video tools such as Kling, Veo 3/3.1, Runway, or Pika, with a portfolio of short clips you've produced



- Proficient in Adobe Photoshop, Canva, or Lightroom for retouching and finishing AI outputs (fixing artifacts, color correction, compositing) and for ad layout and text treatment



- A sharp eye for photorealism: you can spot the tells of AI-generated work (warped elements, melted textures, unnatural shadows, off proportions on furniture and textiles, etc.) and fix them before anyone else sees the file



- Obsessive attention to product accuracy: when comparing your AI output to the actual product photo, you catch the small stuff (a print motif that's slightly off, a flange width that's wrong by a quarter inch, a color that's a shade too warm) and fix it before delivery. The bar is exact match to the real product, not "looks close enough"



- Excellent English skills with high attention to detail and meticulous proofreading of any text or copy in your creatives



- A genuine sense of style and taste in interior design, home decor, and product photography; you understand why a room looks expensive vs. AI-generated stock



- Self-motivated, organized, and professional, with the ability to multi-task and prioritize across multiple brands and brief types; able to work independently with minimal supervision



- Comfortable working with our team via email, Slack, and Zoom. Highly preferred, but not required: experience with Airtable, Notion, Slack, and Google Drive



- Full-time position, 40 hrs/week



- Commitment to the company's mission and values, which can be found here: 



- Excel as a team player, contributing positively to our collective success.





ABOUT HIEND ACCENTS



HiEnd Accents designs and sells premium bedding and home textiles (quilts, sheets, decorative pillows, duvets, and more) that bring everyday luxury into people's homes. We've been family-owned and operated since 2005, now in our second generation of leadership, and are headquartered in Dallas, Texas.



We serve thousands of retailers, interior designers, department stores, and boutique hotels across the United States through four distinct brands spanning a range of styles and price points. Our growth has been recognized nationally: we've been named to the Inc. 5000 (a prestigious list of America's fastest-growing private companies) two years running, and have received multiple industry awards for product excellence.



We're a company of around 45 people, small enough that every person matters, established enough that you're joining something real and growing.



Discover more at 
.





WHY HIEND ACCENTS?



We're growing our team in the Philippines because we believe in finding the best people regardless of geography, and investing in them for the long term.



As a family-owned company, we don't treat our tea
mbers as interchangeable. We take the time to build real working relationships, we care about your professional development, and we want every person who works with us to leave with stronger skills than when they started. That's a genuine commitment from our leadership, not a line in a job posting.



What you can expect:



You'll work directly with our core team in Texas, not through layers of management or a BPO intermediary. Your contributions will be visible, your ideas heard, and your growth supported.



- Compensation & Benefits: Competitive pay benchmarked to PH market rates for skilled roles, not entry-level floors. Paid time off including vacation days and holidays, plus 13th-month pay.



- Real Career Growth: We're expanding quickly, which means new roles and responsibilities open up regularly. We actively develop our people through mentorship, skill-building, and increasing ownership of projects.



- A Team That Feels Like a Team: We're a close, collaborative group that celebrates wins together. You'll know your teammates by name, including leadership.





HiEnd is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Cold Caller
description:
About the Opportunity



We are looking for a motivated, persuasive, and highly energetic Cold Caller to take ownership of our top-of-funnel sales prospecting efforts.

This is a fast-paced opportunity for someone who genuinely enjoys starting conversations, creating interest, overcoming objections, and turning cold prospects into qualified opportunities.

You’ll be the first voice many prospective clients hear, making your ability to communicate clearly, build rapport quickly, and identify genuine buying interest critical to your success.

If you thrive on the phone, are energized by hitting targets, and can confidently turn an initial “no” into a meaningful conversation, this role could be an excellent fit.



Key Responsibilities



Outbound Prospecting

- Execute high-volume daily outbound calls to targeted prospective clients.

- Follow structured scripts while adapting your approach naturally to each conversation.

- Introduce our value proposition clearly and create interest within the first moments of the call.

- Maintain consistent call volume and activity while working toward established performance goals.



Discovery & Lead Qualification

- Conduct concise, high-value discovery conversations to understand prospect needs and pain points.

- Identify decision-makers and key stakeholders.

- Evaluate prospect fit, needs, timing, and budget.

- Identify buying signals and determine when a prospect is ready for the next step.

- Convert qualified interest into booked discovery calls and product demonstrations.



Objection Handling & Engagement

- Confidently navigate gatekeepers and initial resistance.

- Handle objections using active listening, empathy, and strategic questioning.

- Adapt your approach when prospects go off-script.

- Turn passive interest into active engagement and meaningful sales conversations.

- Maintain professionalism and confidence throughout every interaction.



CRM & Activity Tracking

- Accurately record calls, prospect responses, notes, outcomes, and follow-up schedules in the CRM.

- Keep prospect information current and organized.

- Ensure qualified leads are properly transitioned to account executives.

- Follow up consistently with prospects according to established schedules.



What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who is confident, resilient, articulate, competitive, and genuinely enjoys sales conversations.

Ideal candidates will have:

- Previous experience in high-volume outbound telemarketing, appointment setting, cold calling, or inside sales.

- An exceptionally clear, engaging, and professional English-speaking voice.

- Strong conversational skills and the ability to build rapport quickly.

- Excellent active listening and objection-handling abilities.

- The ability to identify subtle buying signals during fast-paced conversations.

- High emotional stamina and the ability to remain positive through frequent rejection.

- Strong focus and consistency when performing repetitive outbound activities.

- Experience using auto-dialers, CRM platforms, or sales engagement tools.

- Strong organizational skills and accurate documentation habits.

- A results-oriented mindset and desire to continuously improve.

- Spanish-speaking ability is a plus.



What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means consistently creating qualified sales opportunities from cold conversations.

You’ll be expected to:

- Maintain strong daily calling activity.

- Generate meaningful conversations with prospective clients.

- Qualify prospects accurately.

- Book high-quality discovery calls and demos.

- Maintain strong prospect show-up rates.

- Handle objections without losing momentum.

- Keep CRM records accurate and up to date.

- Consistently improve your approach based on call results and feedback.



How to Apply

If you thrive on phone sales, enjoy hunting for new opportunities, and know how to capture a decision-maker’s attention quickly, we’d love to hear from you.



Please submit your resume along with a brief 1–2 minute audio recording demonstrating:

Your telephone voice and communication style.



A short introduction or sales pitch.

How you would respond to an initial objection during a cold call.

## PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING

Your job is to contact these leads, build rapport, qualify them, overcome objections, follow up consistently, and book qualified appointments for our real estate agents.



We are looking for someone who has **already done this successfully for North American companies for at least 5 years and can demonstrate their results.**



## WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Call and follow up with inbound buyer and seller leads.

- Build rapport and establish trust quickly.

- Qualify prospects and identify motivation and timelines.

- Handle objections confidently and professionally.

- Convert internet leads into qualified appointments.

- Nurture longer-term prospects through consistent follow-up.

- Maintain accurate CRM records.

- Meet and exceed appointment and conversion targets.



## REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



You must have:



- **Minimum 5 years of professional ISA, inside sales, or appointment-setting experience working with North American companies/customers.**

- Proven experience converting inbound internet leads.

- A strong record of consistently booking qualified appointments.

- **Exceptional spoken English — fluent, natural, professional, confident, and extremely easy to understand over the phone.**

- Excellent rapport-building and objection-handling skills.

- Strong CRM experience.

- Ability to work independently and maintain disciplined follow-up.

- Availability during Ottawa/North American business hours.

- Reliable high-speed internet and a professional home-office environment.



**Real estate ISA experience is strongly preferred.**



## EMPLOYMENT STABILITY IS IMPORTANT



We are looking for someone who wants a **long-term career**, not someone who changes jobs every few months.



Your résumé must clearly show the **exact month and year** you started and finished each position with a North American company.



Please use this format:



**Company Name | Country | Position | Month/Year Started – Month/Year Ended**



Example:



**ABC Realty – Canada | Inside Sales Agent | March 2020 – August 2023**



Do not provide only the years.



Preference will be given to candidates who demonstrate strong performance **and a stable employment history with previous employers.**



## COMPENSATION



- Competitive monthly base salary.

- Performance-based commissions.

- **Top performers can earn $1,500–$3,000+ USD per month.**

- Long-term career and advancement opportunities.



## HOW TO APPLY — IMPORTANT



### 1. VOICE RECORDING — REQUIRED



Send a **1–2 minute voice recording** introducing yourself and explaining:



- Your ISA/inside-sales background.

- How many years you've worked with North American companies.

- Your experience converting inbound leads.

- Why you believe you would be successful in this position.



**We will listen to your voice recording BEFORE reviewing your résumé.**



Because you'll be speaking directly with Canadian buyers and sellers, exceptional spoken English and clear, natural communication are essential.



**If you do not provide a voice recording, we will not review your résumé.**



### 2. DETAILED RÉSUMÉ



Your résumé must show **month/year start and end dates** for every relevant position, particularly positions with North American companies.



### 3. SHOW US YOUR RESULTS



Please also tell us:



- How many inbound leads you handled per month in your most recent ISA role.

- How many qualified appointments you personally booked per month.

- Your conversion rate, if known.

- Your biggest measurable ISA achievement.

- The longest position you've held.

- Why you left your most recent position.

- Which CRM systems you've used.



Top candidates should be comfortable discussing actual numbers and results.



Shortlisted candidates may also be asked to complete a **live role-play** so we can evaluate rapport building, objection handling, qualification, and appointment-setting ability.



## FINAL INSTRUCTION



To demonstrate that you've carefully read this entire posting, include the word **Closer** in the subject line of your application.



**No voice recording = résumé will not be reviewed.**



**Less than 5 years of relevant North American ISA experience = please do not apply.**



We are not looking for an average appointment setter.



**We're looking for a proven ISA who can turn opportunities into appointments, has a history of producing results, and is looking for a long-term career.**

title: Video Editor & YouTube Growth Specialist
description:
Location: Remote

7:00 AM – 4:00 PM Pacific Time (PST), 



Monday - Friday (Full time - 8 hours - 1 hour lunch break)

About the Role

We’re looking for a talented Video Editor & YouTube Growth Specialist to help us grow our YouTube channel and expand our content across social media platforms.



This role is ideal for someone who understands that great social media content is about more than simply editing a video. You should know how to capture attention, maintain viewer retention, create strong hooks, and package content in a way that makes people want to click and watch.



You’ll primarily work with video footage that we provide and turn it into engaging YouTube videos and short-form content for platforms such as YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram Reels, and
.



We’re especially interested in someone who understands how YouTube works and can contribute ideas about what makes content perform, how to improve retention, and how to grow a channel over time.







About AppAid



AppAid is a dedicated Social Security advocacy group committed to assisting individuals with disabilities who are unable to work full-time. Our mission is to guide and support clients through the Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) and Supplemental Security Income (SSI) application and claims process, ensuring they receive the benefits they deserve.



As our company continues to grow, we’re investing in our digital presence to expand our YouTube and social media channels and reach more people with helpful, engaging content about the disability benefits process. We’re looking for talented individuals to help us grow that audience and support our continued growth.





What You'll Do

Edit engaging YouTube videos and short-form social media content



Turn raw footage into compelling, polished videos designed to maximize viewer retention



Identify strong moments, hooks, and storylines within longer footage



Create engaging openings that capture attention within the first few seconds



Add captions, graphics, B-roll, sound effects, music, zooms, transitions, and other elements when appropriate



Create high-click-through-rate YouTube thumbnails



Develop multiple thumbnail or title concepts when appropriate



Repurpose longer videos into Shorts, TikToks, Reels, and other social content



Adapt editing styles and formats for different platforms



Help identify trends, formats, and content opportunities that could help grow the channel



Collaborate with our team on video concepts, hooks, titles, thumbnails, and overall content strategy



Stay up to date with YouTube and short-form video trends within the Social Security Disability niche





What We're Looking For/Required:

Strong video editing skills



Experience editing content specifically for YouTube/Shorts and/or social media



Strong understanding of pacing, storytelling, hooks, and viewer retention



Ability to create professional and attention-grabbing thumbnails



Strong visual and creative instincts



Ability to take raw footage and identify the most engaging moments



Ability to receive and implement feedback promptly, making requested revisions accurately and within a reasonable timeframe



Reliable communication and ability to meet deadlines



Strong attention to detail



Strongly Preferred:



Demonstrated experience using video editing and content strategy to grow a YouTube channel, including measurable improvements in views, watch time, subscribers, or engagement

Experience developing YouTube thumbnails



Experience with A/B testing or experimenting with different hooks, titles, thumbnails, or editing styles



Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, CapCut, Photoshop, or similar tools







The ideal candidate is creative, curious, and focused on results. They should be able to look at a piece of footage and think:



"What is going to make someone stop scrolling?"

"What will make them keep watching?"

"What's the strongest moment in this footage?"

"How can we package this so someone wants to click?"



You should be comfortable bringing ideas to the table and explaining why you think a particular edit, hook, thumbnail, or format could perform better.





As part of the application process, shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a short editing exercise using raw footage provided by us. The exercise will involve creating a 15–30 second social media video so we can better understand your editing style, creativity, pacing, and ability to create an engaging hook.

title: DTC Funnel Optimization Specialist - PH based
description:
About The Visionary Group (TVG)



Welcome to The Visionary Group. We are a close knit e-commerce growth team of brand builders, strategists, and marketers. We help companies scale to maximum their true potential by exploring DTC solutions best suit for their stage of business. Founded in 2022, our collection of fast paced tea
mbers is becoming filled with high priority work, which is where you come in!



What this position is responsible for:



We’re looking for a highly analytical and execution-focused DTC Funnel Optimization Specialist who can identify conversion bottlenecks, implement high-impact fixes, and continuously improve the customer journey across our eCommerce client portfolio. This role exists to bridge the gap between paid acquisition and on-site conversion performance, ensuring traffic generated by our Paid Media Strategists converts at the highest possible rate. You’ll own the diagnosis, testing, implementation, and reporting of funnel improvements while helping scale winning conversion strategies across multiple brands. 



Requirements/Experience:



- 2+ years of experience in Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), DTC eCommerce, funnel optimization, or Shopify growth operations



- Strong working knowledge of Shopify and DTC customer acquisition funnels



- Experience using tools such as GA4, Triple Whale, Shopify Analytics, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, or similar analytics platforms



- Hands-on experience building and updating landing pages and pre-sale pages using Replo or similar no-code builders



- Familiarity with quiz funnel platforms such as Octane AI, Shop Quiz, TryNow, or related tools



- Experience implementing and analyzing A/B tests using tools like Convert, GLO, Intelligems, or equivalent testing platforms



- Strong understanding of key eCommerce conversion metrics including LP CVR, PDP CVR, ATC rate, checkout completion rate, AOV, and funnel conversion flow



- Ability to write high-converting CRO-focused copy including headlines, CTAs, benefit-driven bullets, and trust-building messaging



- Strong analytical thinking with the ability to prioritize opportunities based on impact and effort



- Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple client funnels simultaneously



- Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with Paid Media Strategists and internal stakeholders



- High attention to detail and strong bias toward execution and accountability



- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, performance-driven remote environment



Roles & Responsibilities for this position:



- Conduct monthly audits of each client’s full acquisition funnel, including the transition from ad creative to landing page/PDP, add-to-cart flow, checkout experience, and post-purchase confirmation journey



- Analyze funnel performance data using GA4, Triple Whale, Shopify Analytics, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, and related tools to identify drop-off points, friction areas, and conversion opportunities



- Develop and maintain a prioritized “funnel fix queue” for each client based on projected revenue lift, implementation effort, and business impact



- Collaborate closely with Paid Media Strategists to identify and communicate systemic funnel issues, including disconnects between ad messaging and landing page experience



- Build, launch, and optimize pre-sale pages in Replo to support paid acquisition campaigns and improve conversion performance



- Create, update, and maintain quiz funnels using tools such as Octane AI, Shop Quiz, TryNow, and similar platforms

Implement updates to product detail pages (PDPs) using Shopify-native apps and templated modules without requiring custom Liquid development



- Launch and optimize landing pages designed specifically for paid traffic campaigns and conversion-focused customer journeys



- Execute structured A/B testing initiatives using platforms such as Convert, GLO, or Intelligems, ensuring proper setup, tracking, and reporting



- Write and refine conversion-focused copy for headlines, subheads, product bullets, CTAs, badges, and other on-site conversion elements



- Run a minimum of two A/B tests per client each month, continuously iterating based on performance insights and learnings



- Maintain a centralized testing log documenting hypotheses, variants, results, learnings, and next-step recommendations across all client accounts



- Identify winning conversion patterns and scalable best practices, then templatize and implement them across the broader client portfolio



- Own and monitor core funnel performance metrics including landing page CVR, PDP CVR, ATC rate, checkout completion rate, AOV, quiz completion rate, and quiz-to-purchase rate



- Provide weekly funnel performance updates and actionable insights to Paid Media Strategists via Slack



- Contribute funnel performance insights and scorecard data to monthly client reporting deliverables



- Take full ownership of implementation timelines, optimization initiatives, and measurable funnel performance improvements across assigned accounts



Notes:

- Must be available to work CST hours

- ASAP hire - immediate availability preferred

- Must be based in the Philippines



Apply now!

title: HIRING: Video Editor for a Fast-Growing DTC Brand
description:
HIRING: Video Editor (Full-Time, Remote) for a Fast-Growing DTC Brand



About Us

We're a fast-growing DTC brand in the pet space, scaling to 7 figures with performance-driven video ads on Meta. Every ad we launch is built on research and data and made to convert. We're looking for a video editor who doesn't just edit but thinks like a marketer, and who wants to grow, push limits, and create winning ads at scale.



The Role

We're hiring a Video Editor who can consistently deliver high-performing short-form and long-form video ads. This is a long-term, fully remote role with a base salary plus bonuses on winning ads. For the right person, it's also a stepping stone into a future Creative Strategist role on our team.



What You'll Do



 • Edit 12–15 high-converting video ads per week for Meta and other paid social platforms

 • Bring scripts to life with strong hooks, pacing, captions, sound design, and storytelling

 • Create and edit AI generated content, avatars, voiceovers, B-roll, product visuals, and animations

 • Source stock b-roll, clips, and voiceovers to fill out each concept

 • Edit UGC-style ads, advertorial-style ads, and VSLs

 • Iterate quickly based on performance data (hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CVR)

 • Experiment with new AI tools, formats, and angles



You Need



 • Proven experience editing direct response or performance ads (UGC, paid social)

 • A portfolio of ads that shows it

 • Strong editing skills in Premiere Pro, CapCut, or similar (After Effects is a plus)

 • Hands-on experience creating ads with AI tools like HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Veo, Kling, Higgsfield, Runway, Midjourney, and Nano Banana. AI is at the core of how we make our ads, so this is a must, not a nice-to-have.

 • Clear, fluent English

 • Sharp attention to detail: captions, cuts, and timing done right the first time

 • An understanding of hooks, retention, and why an ad performs

 • Motivation and hunger to succeed, grow, and be part of something early



Big plus: Experience with health, supplement, or pet brands, or a background in copywriting or creative strategy.



What You'll Get



🚀 A real growth path: the right person can move into a future Creative Strategist role, with a big jump in pay and a percentage from their own winning ads

💰 OTE of $1000–$2,500+/month (base plus bonuses on winning ads), depending on experience

🌎 Fully remote

🤝 Long-term role working directly with the founder



How to Apply

Send your portfolio or links to past performance ads, plus a few lines about yourself. Start your application with the word "orange" so we know you read this far. Applications without it won't be reviewed.

title: AI Graphic Designer – Direct Response E-commerce
description:
AI Graphic Designer – E-commerce / Performance Marketing



Are YOU an experienced Graphic Designer with a strong background in e-commerce and performance marketing?

Do you excel at creating high-converting static creatives for fast-paced digital brands?

Are you highly skilled in using AI tools to improve creative quality, speed, volume, and performance?

Do you understand what makes a graphic stop the scroll, communicate a message instantly, and drive action?



If you answered an enthusiastic “YES”, then KEEP READING.



We are Renovae, a fast-growing skincare e-commerce brand based in Europe. We’re looking for a full-time Graphic Designer to join and strengthen our existing creative team.



This is a unique opportunity to play an important role in building and scaling our graphic design department, with the potential to grow into a Senior Graphic Designer / Creative Lead / Head of Creative position as the company expands.



We already have an established internal creative workflow, but we highly value proactive people who bring new ideas, challenge existing processes, and actively contribute to improving our workflows, creative output, and advertising performance.



We need someone to take responsibility for:

- Creating high-converting static ads and graphic creatives for Meta Ads and other paid-media platforms.

- Turning marketing concepts, customer insights, and advertising angles into compelling visual creatives.

- Creating multiple variations of the same concept, including different headlines, hooks, copy, layouts, visuals, offers, and angles for creative testing.

- Understanding and analyzing hooks, concepts, messaging, and creative structures to identify what could improve performance.

- Creating direct-response creatives designed specifically around attention, curiosity, persuasion, and conversion.

- Using AI tools extensively to generate, enhance, edit, and manipulate images, product visuals, backgrounds, creative concepts, and other visual assets.

- Experimenting with new AI technologies to increase the speed and volume of creative production without sacrificing quality.

- Repurposing creatives across multiple platforms, markets, formats, and advertising angles.

- Working closely with our marketing, media buying, and creative teams to develop new concepts and improve advertising performance.

- Supporting our
 marketing department by creating graphics and visual assets for our daily
 campaigns, promotions, launches, and customer communications.

- Creating graphics for landing pages, product launches, promotions, social media, internal projects, and other areas of the business when needed.

- Maintaining brand consistency while continuously experimenting with new visual styles and creative approaches.

- Contributing ideas and feedback to continuously improve our internal creative workflows.

- Working quickly and meeting deadlines without sacrificing quality.

- Staying constantly updated on new AI technologies, design tools, creative trends, advertising formats, and developments in the performance-marketing space.





Position Requirements:



- Proven experience as a Graphic Designer, with a strong portfolio required.

- At least 3 years of professional experience as a Graphic Designer for e-commerce brands, digital brands, advertising agencies, or performance-marketing teams.

- Strong understanding of direct-response advertising and performance creative. We are looking for someone who understands that good design isn't only about aesthetics — it needs to generate results.

- Excellent understanding of creative testing, including the ability to create meaningful variations of headlines, hooks, copy, layouts, images, offers, and visual concepts.

- Excellent command of AI tools and a strong ability to integrate artificial intelligence into daily graphic-design workflows. This is a key requirement for the role.

- Advanced skills in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, or similar design software.

- Advanced knowledge of AI-powered creative platforms such as Nano Banana, Midjourney, Flux, Higgsfield, ChatGPT, and similar tools.

- Strong knowledge of direct-response advertising, e-commerce creative, conversion-focused design, and social-media advertising trends.

- Ability to understand why a creative works — or doesn't work — and use that understanding to develop stronger variations.

- A genuine growth mindset and a strong desire to continuously learn, experiment, and stay ahead of new technologies.

- Creativity, speed, attention to detail, and a strong problem-solving mindset.

- Proficient in English, which is our main working language. Knowledge of French or Spanish is a plus.

- Ability to work within the CET time zone, especially for weekly meetings and team alignment.

- Ability to take full ownership of the role and drive results without constant supervision.

- A proactive and collaborative attitude, with the confidence to suggest improvements and contribute new ideas.





What we offer:



- Full-time, 100% remote position.

- Compensation starting from a competitive base salary, with room to grow as you bring value and results to the brand.

- The opportunity to join an existing creative team and help build a stronger, more structured, and performance-driven graphic design department.

- A clear growth path toward a Senior Graphic Designer / Creative Lead / Head of Creative position.

- A fast-moving environment where speed, experimentation, and quality go hand in hand.

title: Customer Service Agent
description:
About Us

We're a fast-growing international e-commerce brand selling to customers in the UK, Europe and the US. We're building a world-class online customer experience, and our e-commerce team is at the centre of it. We're looking for a dedicated Customer Care Agent to join the team and help us give every customer a smooth, fast and memorable experience from checkout to delivery.



About the Role

As our Customer Care Agent, you'll be the first point of contact for our customers. You'll handle queries across
, live chat and social channels, make sure issues are resolved quickly and properly, and represent our brand with professionalism and warmth. This is a great opportunity for someone who takes pride in their work, enjoys solving problems and wants to grow with an ambitious international business.



What You'll Be Doing

You'll respond to all customer queries promptly and accurately through our helpdesk, covering order updates, returns, exchanges, refunds and product questions. You'll liaise with our fulfilment partners, service providers and couriers to get updates and technical support. You'll track down missing, delayed or damaged packages and keep customers updated until each case is closed. You'll work with other departments, including operations, logistics and marketing, to resolve more complex queries. You'll also help spot recurring issues and suggest improvements to our processes and customer experience.



What We're Looking For

You'll need at least 2 years of experience using ticket-handling software such as Gorgias, Zendesk, Freshdesk or similar, and at least 2 years of Shopify experience. Excellent written and spoken English is essential. You should be able to work under pressure, manage a high volume of tickets and juggle multiple tasks without losing attention to detail. We want someone who solves problems naturally, works well in a team, builds strong relationships, and wants to grow with the business long term. Experience supporting UK, EU or US customers, or with international shipping and customs queries, is a strong plus.



Equipment Requirements

You'll need a reliable PC or laptop, a webcam, a good-quality microphone or headset, and a stable high-speed internet connection, plus a backup power or internet option.



Working Hours

This is a full-time remote role. Your shift will need to overlap with UK business hours.



How to Apply

Please send your application with your CV, a short summary of your customer service and Shopify experience, the helpdesk tools you've used, and your expected monthly salary in USD or PHP. Applications without a salary expectation won't be considered. To show us you've read this ad, start your application with the words "Customer First".

title: Marketing Operations Executor — US Healthcare Company (Remote) — 30-Day Full-Time Build, Then Part-Time
description:
Access Plus Health is a US healthcare compliance company founded by a Harvard-trained, board-certified physician. We are hiring a remote marketing executor for a 30-day full-time build phase, converting to part-time (20–25 hrs/week) once the build is done. This role is execution-focused: the founder sets strategy and provides AI-drafted content; you build, launch, manage, and report. You will work heavily with AI tools — we expect it — but you must be able to operate the platforms yourself, live.



What you will do:



1. Manage paid ads on Meta and Google from provided campaign structure: tracking setup (UTMs, pixel/CAPI), budget management, weekly reporting. Ads launch only after tracking is verified.



2.  Run outbound distribution: LinkedIn engagement and scheduling for the founder's account,
 group participation (Phase 1); webinar promotion and referral partner follow-up sequences (Phase 2)



3. Edit, format, and publish SEO articles from AI-assisted drafts (all content physician-reviewed before publishing) — ongoing cadence of 2/week is Phase 2 scope; Phase 1 focuses on the attribution/sequence/reactivation/ads build



4. Build and manage
 campaigns and automations in GoHighLevel from provided sequence specs (new-lead follow-up, reactivation, newsletter)



5. Maintain CRM hygiene and produce a weekly one-page report: leads, cost per lead,
 metrics, pipeline contribution





Requirements: 

- 5+ years marketing execution for US clients — you have personally run paid campaigns and built marketing automations at real volume, not coordinated a team that did; 

- hands-on GoHighLevel (or HubSpot/ActiveCampaign + fast GHL ramp); 

- personally managed Meta/Google campaigns including tracking; 

- excellent written English; fixed daily overlap hours with US Eastern, with same-day response on urgent items during that window (in writing in the offer).



Compensation — two phases, both stated here. This is a remote, globally-sourced role, and the rate below reflects an international market rate rather than a US-based salary.



Phase 1 (Days 1–30, full-time build): $1,200–$2,000/month based on experience — roughly $7–$12/hour. Default length is 30 days; may finish sooner for a strong performer with no reduction in the month's pay. Extends day-for-day at the full Phase 1 rate only if the delay is caused by APH (review turnaround, account access, portal) — not for candidate pace.



Phase 2 (Day 31 onward): part-time at ~20–25 hrs/week, with pay scaled proportionally from the Phase 1 rate and a small fixed daily overlap with US Eastern hours so urgent items still get a same-day response, both stated in writing.



Bonus: $150–$300/month on qualified-lead targets, carried through both phases and becoming a larger share of total pay once base hours drop.



Day-30 fork (APH's option, not a promise): if performance clearly warrants it, APH may keep this hire full-time at the Phase 1 rate with expanded scope folded in (CRM ownership, proposal support, follow-up sequencing) instead of converting to part-time.



Paid live working session before hire.

title: Full-Time // Law Firm Position // Case Acquisition & Intake Coordinator
description:
Headline: Full-Time // Law Firm Position // Case Acquisition & Intake Coordinator 



Molinary Law Firm, LLC Introduction: Molinary Law is a personal injury law firm that provides legal aid to personal injury clients (mainly victims of motor vehicle collisions) in the State of Georgia, within the United States of America. Molinary Law is owned and operated by Attorney Edward Molinary and Attorney Gabrielle Molinary. Edward and Gabrielle are a husband-and-wife team, and they manage the limited liability company together. Learn more by visiting 
. 



Job Title: Case Acquisition & Intake Coordinator



Job Description: The Case Acquisition & Intake Coordinator will be an employee of the Operations Department who assists with the day-to-day internal operations of Molinary Law. This is a business role, not a legal role. Molinary Law has three internal departments: Pre-Litigation, Litigation, and Operations. The Case Acquisition & Intake Coordinator will serve as an executive assistant to the Operations Manager, and to both Edward and Gabrielle, by facilitating tasks that are necessary for the sustainability and growth of the practice. This position requires exceptional organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently. Maintaining a high level of professionalism and confidentiality is of the utmost importance. 



Job Responsibilities: Training will be provided to educate the Case Acquisition & Intake Coordinator on the finer details of the law practice. The Case Acquisition & Intake Coordinator will be informed of the firm’s short-term and long-term business goals, and they will be responsible for making sure those goals are met. KPI tracking and reporting are mandatory parts of the job. The comfort and success of the Case Acquisition & Intake Coordinator is very important to both Edward and Gabrielle. Support will be given freely, and open and frequent communication will be modeled and expected in return. 



The Case Acquisition & Intake Coordinator will be responsible for the following:  



Social Media

- Manage Molinary Law’s social media presence across all social media platforms.

- Develop and maintain a consistent social media content calendar.

- Create, coordinate, and publish social media posts, reels, videos, stories, etc. 

- Develop content designed to increase brand awareness and generate potential new client inquiries.

- Coordinate photography, videography, editing, graphic design, and other creative marketing needs. 

- Monitor post engagement, comments, directed messages via analytics management. 

- Use and maintain law firm marketing platforms such as Levitate.

- Monitor all firm Google reviews.



Marketing & Lead Generation

- Develop and execute marketing initiatives designed to generate potential new clients. 

- Identify new opportunities for Molinary Law to reach potential new clients. 

- Coordinate digital, print, community, referral, and other marketing initiatives.

- Manage relationships with outside marketing vendors. 

- Coordinate Molinary Law’s adverting campaigns and all promotional materials.

- Assist with website content, blogs, and SEO efforts. 

- Monitor competitors and identify relevant marketing trends and opportunities.



Lead Tracking & Conversion

- Monitor all incoming leads from all marketing channels and identify which marketing efforts are generating the most quality cases. 

- Maintain accurate data tracking and provide reports for Attorney review.



Intake & New Clients

- Manage Dialpad for Molinary Law. 

- Act as the firm’s legal receptionist. 

- Respond promptly to prospective new client inquiries. 

- Conduct prospective new client intake calls.

- Explain Molinary Law’s mission and policies.

- Coordinate next-step client consultations with Attorneys.

- Follow-up via phone,
, and text with new clients and/or prospective new clients. 

- Prepare newly signed clients for handoff to the appropriate department for next steps. 

- Manage and complete the Pre-Litigation Department’s New Client Intake Forms. 

- Set-up new client profiles across all law firm systems, such as CASEpeer and Case Status.



The Bigger Picture Workflow: Prospective Client--Newly Signed Client--Active Client



The Case Acquisition & Intake Coordinator is not a social media person who happens to also answer intake calls. Instead, they own Molinary law’s front-end client acquisition and intake process. They are responsible for the firm’s entire case generation and onboarding pipeline. 



Edward and Gabrielle will periodically add projects to this list of job responsibilities and will collaborate with the Operations Manager and the Case Acquisition & Intake Coordinator on these projects.



It is important to note that Molinary Law is an actively growing personal injury law practice. Edward and Gabrielle already employ a staff (some members of which are also virtual assistants located in the Philippines) and are currently scaling their business and taking the necessary steps to increase their case intake to add to their current caseload. The Case Acquisition & Intake Coordinator should be prepared to take on more responsibilities as the practice grows. This will gradually happen as time passes and trust builds with Edward and Gabrielle.



Job Details: 

- The official start date for this position is Tuesday, October 13, 2026.

- This is a full-time position.

- The Case Acquisition & Intake Coordinator must be willing to work during daylight hours in the Eastern Standard Time Zone.

- There is a 6-week probationary period upon hiring.

- The first week of the probationary period will be a training week.

- This is a salaried position:

title: Canine Medical Records & Documentation Specialist
description:
We are an established canine breeding and veterinary services company that has been in business for over 15 years, and we are looking for a trustworthy, highly organized person to join our team long-term.



This is not a temporary position. We are looking for someone who wants stability, takes pride in their work, and would like to grow with a company for many years.



Honesty, loyalty, reliability, and attention to detail are extremely important to us.



You will be trusted with canine medical records, health-testing documents, company files, and other important information. We need someone who can be trusted to handle that responsibility professionally and who communicates honestly if a mistake is made or something does not look correct.



Work Schedule



This is a full-time position:



Monday–Friday

9:00 AM–5:00 PM Eastern Time (U.S.)



You must be consistently available during these hours.



What You’ll Be Doing



Your primary responsibility will be creating, reviewing, and organizing medical and health records for our dogs and puppies.



Your responsibilities will include:



* Creating canine vaccination and medical records using our Canva templates

* Entering puppy names, dates of birth, microchip numbers, vaccinations, medications, and other medical information

* Using formulas and prompts we provide in ChatGPT to calculate vaccination, medication, and treatment dates

* Carefully checking all dates and information for accuracy

* Editing existing Canva templates

* Exporting completed records into professional PDFs

* Creating and editing additional PDF documents and forms

* Adding authorized signatures or signature areas when instructed

* Watermarking medical and health-testing documents

* Organizing records and documents in Google Drive

* Organizing canine health-testing results in Dropbox

* Creating and maintaining individual folders for dogs

* Correctly naming and filing documents according to our system

* Checking folders to make sure required health-testing records are present

* Creating informational sheets, forms, instructions, and other professional documents



The Person We Are Looking For



The right person for this job is someone who enjoys organization and notices small details.



You should be someone who notices when a date is incorrect, a document is in the wrong folder, a dog’s information does not match, or something is missing.



You also need to be comfortable performing repetitive tasks. Many of our medical records follow the same process, but every record must be completed accurately.



We are looking for someone who is:



* Honest and trustworthy

* Loyal and interested in long-term employment

* Extremely organized

* Detail-oriented

* Dependable and consistent

* Comfortable working with dates and numbers

* Comfortable performing repetitive administrative work

* Able to follow detailed instructions

* Able to work independently

* Comfortable learning new procedures

* Good at managing digital files and folders

* Willing to double-check their own work

* Comfortable asking questions instead of guessing



We understand that everyone makes mistakes. What matters to us is that you are honest about them, communicate with us, correct them, and learn from them.



Required Skills



You should already be comfortable using:



* Google Drive

* Google Docs

* Dropbox

* Canva

* PDF editing tools

* ChatGPT



Experience working with medical records, veterinary records, health documents, administrative files, or other accuracy-sensitive information is a plus but is not required.



We can teach you our systems and canine medical protocols. We cannot teach someone to care about accuracy, honesty, organization, and doing a job correctly.



Compensation & Long-Term Opportunity



Starting pay: $800 USD per month



This is a full-time, long-term position with an established company that has been operating for more than 15 years.



We value employees who stay with us, learn our systems, become dependable members of the team, and take ownership of their responsibilities.



We are looking for someone who wants a stable position and a company they can grow with — not someone who plans to work for a few months and move on.



How to Apply



Please include:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your experience organizing Google Drive folders and files

3. Your experience with Dropbox

4. Your experience with Canva

5. Your experience creating or editing PDFs

6. Any experience working with medical, veterinary, administrative, or detail-sensitive records

7. Your experience using ChatGPT

8. Confirmation that you can consistently work 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday through Friday

9. How soon you are available to start

10. What you are looking for in a long-term employer



Please also answer these two questions:



Do you enjoy repetitive, detail-oriented work where accuracy is more important than speed? Why?



What does being a loyal and trustworthy employee mean to you?



Skills Test



Applicants who appear to be a strong fit will be invited to complete a short skills test before we make a final hiring decision.



You may be asked to:



* Follow instructions to create a sample canine medical record

* Calculate and enter medical dates correctly

* Edit an existing Canva template

* Create or modify a PDF

* Add a watermark to a document

* Properly name and organize files according to instructions



We will be looking closely at accuracy, attention to detail, organization, ability to follow directions, and overall quality of work.



We are not looking for the person who finishes the test the fastest. We are looking for the person who carefully follows the instructions and gets it right.



If you are looking for a stable, long-term position and you are someone who takes pride in being dependable, organized, honest, and accurate, we would love to hear from you.

title: Collections Specialist
description:
About the Opportunity



We are looking for a proactive, confident, and client-focused Collections Specialist to join our team and play a critical role in maintaining healthy client accounts and supporting revenue recovery.

This is more than simply following up on unpaid balances. You’ll work directly with clients to understand billing concerns, resolve account discrepancies, overcome payment obstacles, and find practical solutions that work for both the client and the organization.

The ideal candidate is comfortable having financial conversations, stays composed when handling objections, and takes pride in following through until an issue is fully resolved.



Key Responsibilities



Collections & Revenue Recovery

- Make outbound calls and work assigned collection queues to address unpaid balances and failed payments.

- Prioritize accounts effectively to meet established collection and recovery goals.

- Follow up consistently on outstanding balances and payment commitments.

- Use active listening, professionalism, and persuasive communication to address financial objections.

- Secure appropriate payment commitments and document agreed-upon next steps.



Billing & Account Resolution

- Handle incoming client calls regarding billing questions and invoice disputes.

- Clearly explain charges, invoices, billing cycles, and account balances.

- Investigate account discrepancies and coordinate appropriate resolutions.

- Respond promptly to missed calls, messages, and client inquiries.

- Ensure billing concerns are followed through to complete resolution.



Payment Solutions

- Guide clients through customized payment plans and available payment options.

- Assist clients with setting up automatic payments.

- Explain and facilitate available third-party financing solutions.

- Help identify practical payment solutions while maintaining established policies and procedures.



Documentation & CRM Management

- Accurately document client calls,
s, payment commitments, disputes, and follow-up activities.

- Maintain complete and up-to-date account records within assigned CRM and billing systems.

- Track outstanding issues and follow-up requirements to ensure nothing falls through the cracks.

- Maintain a complete record of client interactions and account resolutions.



What We’re Looking For

The ideal candidate will be organized, persistent, confident on the phone, and comfortable discussing financial matters with clients.

Qualifications include:

- Proven experience in collections, accounts receivable, legal billing, or a related financial role.

- Strong telephone presence and excellent verbal communication skills.

- Excellent active listening and conflict-resolution abilities.

- Ability to handle financial objections and difficult conversations professionally.

- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

- High technical aptitude and the ability to quickly learn new systems.

- Hands-on experience with legal billing software or CRM systems is highly preferred.

- Ability to independently manage repetitive, detail-oriented workflows.

- Strong follow-through and accountability.

- Ability to work effectively in a fully remote environment.

- A quiet, dedicated home-office setup suitable for handling client calls.

- Spanish-speaking ability is a plus.



What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means consistently moving accounts toward resolution while ensuring clients receive clear, respectful, - and professional communication.

You'll be expected to:

- Stay on top of assigned collection queues.

- Follow through consistently on outstanding accounts.

- Resolve billing questions and disputes efficiently.

- Secure and document payment commitments.

- Keep CRM and billing records accurate and complete.

- Ensure clients understand their payment options.

- Close the loop on every outstanding issue.



Schedule

Monday–Friday | 9:00 AM–5:00 PM EST

Fully Remote



How to Apply

If you have experience in collections, billing, accounts receivable, or legal billing and are confident in communicating with clients about financial matters, we'd love to hear from you.



Please submit your updated resume highlighting your collections, billing, or accounts receivable experience.

title: Website Content & Design Coordinator
description:
We're looking for a detail-oriented Website Content & Design Coordinator to join our team and take ownership of content fills and website setup for new jewelry client websites. This is a hands-on, execution-focused role. You'll be turning approved designs into fully built, polished, launch-ready websites.



This role does not include mockup design or custom graphic design work (that's handled by a separate designer). Instead, you'll focus on bringing sites to life: writing and placing content, selecting images, configuring site structure, and making the small technical tweaks that make a site feel complete and professional.



You will work directly under me, receiving assigned tasks and completing them independently using our internal tools and workflows.



What You'll Do:

- Content fills: Write and insert page text, select and place images, add links, and complete on-page content for new client websites

- Website setup: Handle full site configuration including data entry, product/category setup, navigation menus, and footer structure

- Minor development: Make small HTML, CSS, and PHP edits/updates as needed (no heavy dev work, think tweaks, not builds)

- Embeds: Add third-party embeds (widgets, tools, plugins) to pages when required

- Design sensibility: Apply a strong eye for layout, spacing, and visual polish when filling in content. You won't be designing from scratch, but you need to know what looks right

- Stay current: Keep a pulse on trending jewelry styles and modern website navigation/layout patterns so client sites feel current, not dated



Tools You'll Use:

- Slack (team communication)

- JIRA (task management)

- In-house Site Manager software (our proprietary CMS)

- FTP file transfer

- Basic text editor (for minor code edits)

- AI agent tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) for content generation and problem-solving



What We're Looking For:

- 1–3 years of relevant experience in web content, site coordination, or similar

- High English fluency, written communication must be clear and polished (you will not be speaking directly with clients, but content quality reflects on our brand)

- Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and basic PHP

- A genuine eye for design, you notice when something looks off, even if you're not the one designing it

- Jewelry industry interest or background is a strong plus. Familiarity with jewelry terminology, styles, and trends will help you make better content decisions

- Comfortable using AI agents/tools as part of your workflow, and can problem-solve both agentically (with AI assistance) and independently

- Highly organized and able to manage multiple site builds/tasks at once

- Self-directed, able to take an assigned task and run with it with minimal hand-holding



Why Join Us:

- Clear task assignment, no client-facing pressure

- Work with a modern, growing team using AI-forward workflows



Please send:

- A short introduction about yourself

- A Loom (or any screen recording) video showing how you would document a simple website bug or usability issue

- Your resume or OnlineJobs.ph profile link

What We’re Looking For

title: Sales Admin Specialist
description:
About the Opportunity



Are you the organized, detail-oriented person who keeps everything moving behind the scenes?

We are looking for a proactive and highly organized Sales Administrative Specialist to support our sales team and help keep our growth pipeline running smoothly.

In this role, you'll sit at the intersection of sales, administration, and operations. You'll help manage prospect information, coordinate communications, keep our CRM accurate, prepare sales documentation, and ensure our sales representatives have everything they need to move opportunities forward.

Your work will directly support our sales team's ability to spend less time on administrative tasks and more time building relationships and closing deals.

If you're someone who enjoys creating order, keeping track of details, following up on outstanding items, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks, this could be a great fit.



Key Responsibilities



CRM & Sales Data Management

- Maintain accurate and up-to-date prospect and customer information in the CRM.

- Log prospect communications, activities, follow-ups, and deal updates.

- Track contract stages, sales activity, and key pipeline information.

- Perform accurate data entry and regularly identify and correct incomplete or inconsistent records.



Lead Coordination

- Review incoming sales inquiries and ensure prospect information is complete and accurate.

- Assist with initial lead qualification and route opportunities to the appropriate sales representative.

- Coordinate discovery calls, demos, meetings, and other sales activities.

- Ensure leads receive timely follow-up and are properly documented throughout the sales process.



Sales Documentation

- Prepare, review, and distribute standard sales quotes, proposals, agreements, and related documentation.

- Verify pricing, terms, required information, and internal approvals before documents are sent.

- Track outstanding signatures, forms, and supporting documentation.

- Maintain organized records of sales documents throughout the deal lifecycle.



Sales Team Support

- Serve as a reliable administrative partner to sales representatives.

- Coordinate communication between prospects, clients, and internal sales team members.

- Follow up with prospective clients regarding missing information, signatures, documents, or onboarding requirements.

- Help sales representatives stay organized and focused on high-value activities.



Reporting & Sales Operations

- Compile weekly sales activity reports and performance metrics.

- Monitor team activity and progress toward revenue targets.

- Identify delays, recurring administrative issues, and operational bottlenecks.

- Provide sales leadership with accurate information that can help improve pipeline management and team efficiency.



What We’re Looking For

We're looking for someone who is organized, dependable, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced sales environment.

Ideal candidates will have:

- Previous experience as a Sales Administrator, Sales Operations Assistant, Sales Coordinator, or similar role supporting a sales team.

- Hands-on experience with CRM platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, or similar systems.

- Strong proficiency with modern office productivity and communication tools.

- Exceptional organizational and time-management skills.

- Ability to prioritize multiple time-sensitive tasks without losing attention to detail.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- Strong attention to detail, particularly when working with contracts, pricing, numbers, and client information.

- Strong follow-up skills and the ability to keep multiple deals moving simultaneously.

- Ability to work independently and take ownership of routine reporting and administrative responsibilities.

- A reliable, results-focused approach and a willingness to proactively identify problems before they become obstacles.

- Spanish-speaking ability is a plus.

- What Success Looks Like

- In this role, you'll help ensure that:

- Sales data stays accurate and current.

- Leads are properly assigned and followed up with.

- Sales representatives have the information and documents they need.

- Proposals, agreements, and contracts move efficiently through the process.

- Outstanding documents and signatures don't fall through the cracks.

- Sales leadership has reliable pipeline and performance information.

- Administrative bottlenecks are identified and resolved quickly.



Why This Role Matters

Great sales teams need more than great salespeople—they need great operations behind them.

Your organization, follow-through, and attention to detail will help our sales team operate more efficiently, improve the prospect experience, and keep opportunities moving from initial inquiry to closed deal.



How to Apply

If you excel at keeping sales teams organized, maintaining accurate systems, coordinating details, and keeping deal pipelines moving, we'd love to hear from you.



Please submit your resume in English along with a brief statement highlighting your experience supporting sales operations and managing CRM systems.

title: Video Editor ; Cutter – E-Commerce Ads - Part-Time (20 h)

- Continuously explore and test new AI tools and creative workflows.

- Help improve the efficiency and scalability of our creative production process.

- Creative & Performance

- Analyze existing ads and identify opportunities for new creative angles and variations.

- Understand the principles of direct-response and performance marketing.

- Think beyond simply making a video look good and focus on creating content that captures attention and drives action.

- Stay up to date with current eCommerce advertising and creative trends.

- Work closely with the team to iterate and improve creatives based on performance and feedback.



What We're Looking For:

- Strong understanding of what makes an effective direct-response ad.

- Strong skills in video editing software such as Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, or similar.

- Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of assigned tasks.

- Strong attention to detail and a good sense for visual quality.

- Reliable internet connection and a professional home office setup.

- Comfortable using AI tools as part of your daily creative workflow.



Nice to Have:

- Experience working with Meta Ads or TikTok Ads.

- Experience with DTC/eCommerce brands.

- Experience with AI video and image generation tools.

- Experience with AI voice and avatar tools.

- Familiarity with tools such as Runway, Kling, Veo, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Midjourney, ChatGPT, or similar.

- Experience working with high-volume creative production or ad batches.



How to Apply:



If you're a creative and independent Video Editor who understands eCommerce advertising and enjoys experimenting with new AI tools and creative workflows, we'd love to hear from you.

- A short introduction about yourself

title: International Freight Forwarding / Logistics
description:
Efficient Logistics Inc. is seeking a bilingual Operations / Customer Service Representative to support our international freight forwarding operations. This role is not a basic clerical or support position. We are looking for someone who is responsible, self-disciplined, proactive, and able to manage daily operational tasks with a strong sense of ownership in a remote work environment.

The right candidate must be able to follow up on tasks independently, communicate clearly and proactively, and take responsibility for shipment progress instead of waiting for repeated instructions. This role supports ocean and air import/export operations and requires close coordination with customers, overseas agents, carriers, truckers, warehouses, and customs-related parties.

Working Hours

This role requires schedule flexibility based on operational needs and time zone coverage. The expected working hours will generally start around 12:00 PM or 1:00 PM and end around 9:00 PM or 10:00 PM BEIJING Time. The final working schedule may be adjusted after onboarding depending on actual job responsibilities and business needs.

Key Responsibilities

• Serve as the point of contact for customers and provide shipment status updates, shipping options, timelines, and basic logistics guidance.

• Prepare, review, and verify shipping documents, including bills of lading, packing lists, invoices, and customs-related paperwork.

• Coordinate bookings, pickups, deliveries, truckers, warehouses, and other vendors to ensure shipments move on time.

• Track shipment progress and maintain accurate operational records.

• Communicate with customers, agents, truckers, carriers, brokers, and internal team members in both English and Chinese.

• Identify issues such as delays, missing documents, customs holds, or delivery risks, and take immediate follow-up actions.

• Escalate issues clearly with facts, status, and recommended next steps instead of only reporting that there is a problem.

• Support daily operation execution with urgency, accuracy, and accountability.

• Work closely with the team to improve process efficiency and service quality.

Required Qualifications

• 1 to 3 years of experience in freight forwarding, logistics, customer service, shipping coordination, or related operational work preferred.

• Bilingual in English and Mandarin Chinese, both written and spoken.

• Good communication skills and the ability to coordinate with different parties across time zones.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to handle multiple tasks under time pressure.

• Basic proficiency in Microsoft Office,
 communication, and online systems.

• Able to work remotely with discipline, structure, and accountability.

• Willing to work flexible hours when urgent shipments or time-sensitive issues require support.

Required Work Style / Candidate Traits

• Ownership: takes responsibility for assigned work and follows through until completion.

• Proactive communication: does not wait until the last minute to report issues. Communicates early, clearly, and with context.

• Problem-solving mindset: when facing an issue, can explain the problem, identify possible solutions, and recommend next steps.

• Remote work discipline: can manage priorities and workload independently without constant supervision.

• Urgency and accountability: understands which issues are time-sensitive and responds accordingly.

• Reliability: maintains accurate records, meets deadlines, and handles daily tasks consistently.

What Success Looks Like in This Role

• Take ownership of assigned shipments and follow up proactively from start to finish.

• Communicate clearly when there is a delay, issue, missing document, or unclear instruction.

• Manage daily priorities independently in a remote work environment.

• Escalate problems with facts, options, and recommended next steps.

• Avoid simply saying “I cannot finish” without clearly explaining the reason, priority conflict, and proposed solution.

• Show urgency when shipment, customs, delivery, or customer issues may affect service quality.

• Keep customers and internal team members updated in a timely and professional manner

title: Senior Supply Chain Operations Associate — E-commerce / Dropshipping
description:
Senior Supply Chain Operations Associate — E-commerce / Dropshipping



Full-Time | Remote | Compensation: TBD / Based on Experience



We are a multi-store e-commerce company looking for an experienced Senior Supply Chain Operations Associate to take a key ownership role in our fulfillment and delivery operations.



This is not simply an order-processing position.



We are looking for someone with strong e-commerce/dropshipping experience who can identify problems, investigate root causes, coordinate solutions, work with suppliers, use data effectively, and help drive the performance of the overall supply chain operation.



YOUR MISSION



You will help ensure that our supply chain consistently achieves the following targets:



Average fulfillment time: ~3 days or less

Average transit time: ~10 days

Successful delivery rate: 98%+

Continuously reduce OOS, RTS, address issues, stalled shipments, and recurring fulfillment problems



You will work closely with and report directly to management.



WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

Fulfillment & Delivery Operations



Our internal systems increasingly automate order monitoring, KPI calculations, and exception detection.



Your responsibility is to act on those exceptions and make sure they are resolved.



This includes:



Investigating fulfillment delays

Following up on delayed orders

Resolving tracking and transit issues

Handling OOS cases

Coordinating address corrections

Investigating RTS and failed deliveries

Monitoring stalled shipments

Escalating supplier and carrier problems

Identifying recurring operational issues

Following issues through until resolution



We don't want someone who simply reports:



"There is a problem."



We want someone who can tell us:



"Here is the problem, here is why it's happening, here is what we're doing about it, and here is when we expect it to be resolved."



Supplier & Logistics Coordination



You will work directly with suppliers, fulfillment agents, and other logistics partners to:



Follow up on fulfillment delays

Resolve order-level issues

Escalate recurring problems

Monitor supplier performance

Investigate shipping issues

Coordinate replacement sourcing when required

Help improve fulfillment and delivery performance

Data & Automation



We are building a highly automated and data-driven supply chain operation.



You should be comfortable working with:



Shopify and order data

Large spreadsheets and datasets

Dashboards and KPI reports

Fulfillment and tracking data

Automation tools

AI tools



You do not need to be a software developer.



However, you should be able to identify repetitive processes that can be automated, explain the required business logic, and work with our automation team to improve them.



Senior-Level Ownership



Although this is a Senior Associate position, we expect a high level of ownership.



You may be expected to:



Help coordinate the work of other Supply Chain Operations team members

Prioritize operational exceptions

Identify problems before management discovers them

Escalate business-critical issues

Analyze recurring problems and recommend solutions

Help improve SOPs and workflows

Support and guide less experienced team members

Take the lead during urgent supply chain issues



This is a hands-on position. You should be comfortable both coordinating others and personally working on operational issues when necessary.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Proven e-commerce/dropshipping experience

Strong understanding of fulfillment and international shipping

Experience working with suppliers or fulfillment agents

Strong spreadsheet and data-management skills

Strong analytical and problem-solving ability

Ability to identify trends and root causes

Good written English

Comfortable working independently

Strong sense of accountability

Full-time commitment



Experience with Shopify, CJdropshipping or similar suppliers, tracking platforms, dashboards, automation tools, and high-volume e-commerce operations is highly preferred.



THE MINDSET WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We want someone who thinks:



"If I see a problem, I own it until it is resolved or properly escalated."



We don't expect you to be online 24/7.



However, this role requires someone who takes ownership of critical issues and is willing to go above and beyond when the operation requires it.



COMPENSATION



TBD — based on experience, capabilities, and fit for the role.



We are open to discussing compensation with strong candidates.



HOW TO APPLY



Please answer ALL of the following:



1. Describe your previous e-commerce/dropshipping supply chain experience.



2. Approximately how many orders per day or month did the operation you worked with process?



3. Which suppliers, fulfillment agents, carriers, tracking platforms, or e-commerce tools have you worked with?



4. Our average fulfillment time increases from 3 days to 5 days. Walk us through what you would do.



5. Our successful delivery rate drops from 98% to 94%. How would you investigate the cause?



6. Give an example of a supply chain or fulfillment problem you personally identified and solved.



7. What parts of e-commerce supply chain operations do you think should be automated?



8. Tell us about an automation, dashboard, spreadsheet, or process improvement you have personally created or helped implement.



9. Are you comfortable coordinating or guiding other Supply Chain Operations team members when necessary?



10. What is your current employment situation, and can you commit full-time to this role?



11. What is your expected monthly salary in USD?





Start your application with "98% DELIVERY" so we know you read the entire job post.



Applications that do not answer all of the questions above will not be considered.

 correspondence.
